jobs.title: IT&Data Product Analyst - Total Rewards
jobs.description: About The Job As Product Analyst for Total Rewards, you are the technical and operational guarantor of campaign delivery. You secure end-to-end campaign readiness and execution by coordinating configuration activities, performing or validating selected system and data administration interventions, overseeing testing and release preparation, and ensuring that risks, dependencies and issues are actively managed. You also coordinate consultants and Chapter members, animate Agile delivery rituals and maintain the backlog management tool as the reliable source of delivery status. You work closely with the Product Owner and Senior Product Analyst to turn prioritized and technically ready stories into controlled campaign delivery. Depending on your experience and demonstrated capability, you may take increasing ownership of selected configuration and data administration activities within agreed technical guardrails. You ensure that campaign tasks, owners, timelines, blockers, testing evidence and documentation are actively managed, and you escalate higher-risk changes or arbitration needs when required. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Delivery Coordination and Rewards Campaign Execution - Coordinate the operational delivery of Rewards initiatives, enhancements and campaign-related activities - Manage day-to-day follow-up of configuration work performed by consultants and Chapter members - Monitor workload, timeline, progress, risks, blockers, dependencies and quality of deliverables - Ensure that campaign preparation, configuration, testing, release and post-go-live activities are properly followed up - Escalate risks, delays or arbitration needs to the Senior Product Analyst or Product Owner when required Agile Rituals and Backlog Tool Management - Own the preparation, animation and follow-up of the team Daily - Maintain the backlog management tool, ensuring that stories, tasks, owners, statuses, priorities, dependencies and blockers are up to date - Ensure that the Kanban board or backlog management tool is used as the team’s single source of truth for delivery follow-up - Facilitate operational Agile rituals such as Daily meetings, delivery follow-ups, retrospectives, sprint reviews and preparation sessions - Produce delivery visibility through progress updates, dashboards, action lists and risk trackers Configuration Follow-up and Consultant Coordination - Coordinate the pool of external consultants and Chapter members involved in SAP SuccessFactors configuration activities - Track configuration progress and confirm alignment with validated requirements and technical guidance provided by the Senior Product Analyst - Review and validate selected system configurations against approved requirements and technical guidance, and perform limited hands-on technical interventions in SAP SuccessFactors when required, within the agreed scope and under the guidance of the Senior Product Analyst - Support issue tracking, defect resolution and root-cause analysis by gathering facts, evidence and context - Ensure configuration outputs are documented and ready for testing, release and future maintenance Testing, Documentation and Release Support - Prepare, coordinate and execute functional test scenarios where relevant - Support User Acceptance Testing by ensuring clear test scope, test evidence, defect follow-up and stakeholder communication - Maintain requirements traceability, test evidence, release notes and operational documentation - Contribute to demos and delivery sessions for new features, enhancements and campaign readiness Operational Communication - Ensure smooth operational communication between consultants, Chapter members, the Product Owner, the Senior Product Analyst and HR stakeholders - Prepare and present progress reports, delivery dashboards and operational follow-up materials - Help maintain a structured and transparent delivery cadence across the Rewards product team About You We expect you to have: Minimum 2 to 3 years of experience in HRIS, HR Technology, Rewards, compensation processes or a Product Analyst role Experience coordinating consultants, technical contributors or configuration activities Hands-on experience reviewing or maintaining SAP SuccessFactors system configurations and performing HRIS data administration activities, including data validation, uploads, corrections and quality controls Experience supporting HR campaigns, recurring Rewards cycles or SAP SuccessFactors delivery is a strong asset Skills: Good working knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors Rewards configuration, including the ability to review selected settings, understand configuration logic and perform limited system interventions within an approved scope Knowledge of HRIS data administration, including data preparation, validation, uploads, corrections, access-sensitive handling and data quality controls Strong coordination, follow-up, documentation and delivery tracking skills Experience with Agile rituals, Daily meetings, Kanban boards and backlog management tools Ability to work with consultants, technical teams and business stakeholders in a structured and reliable way Attention to detail, operational rigor and problem-solving mindset About Us At the Danone group we are fulfilling our mission, according to which „we bring health to as many people as possible”. Behind our brands is always technology pushing them forward. We know that the future of business is IT and data. That’s why we use advanced and innovative IT solutions which are implemented in all Danone units around the world. For more information about Danone, our divisions and culture, please explore https://careers.danone.com WE OFFER A revolutionary job that will be part of the digital transformation of global FMCG leader. We consider that it starts with people who notice more and make better decisions. And that’s exactly the kind of people we want to attract to DANONE. We know that the future of business is IT and data. We are looking for catalysts for change. We ensure you work with great products, and technologies in an international environment, learning from experts and experienced managers but how much you will develop in this position depends on you! We value smart working so that’s why while being focused on results, we offer flexible working hours and a home office policy. You are able to work from the office in Warsaw twice a week. Want to move to Warsaw? OK! We have a relocation package to help you out! On top of that, you will have access to the benefits we offer to you and your family, including private medical care, benefits package for parents, life insurance, social fund, or employee discounts. We’ve always been changers. WHAT NEXT? Click the “Apply” button and create your profile in the recruitment system by uploading a CV. We will get acquainted with your experience and then we will arrange the selected candidates for the first telephone interview. Next steps are two meetings with your future managers at Danone. Do not hesitate and join our IT&DATA Team in Poland which vision is that the technology is a strategic differentiator for DANONE, powered by an IT agile organization. We embrace diversity in our organization. This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants without attention to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability status. ---- Danone Sp. z o.o. with its registered office in Warsaw (ul. jobs.title: Director of Insurance and Risk Management
jobs.description: About the Job The Director, Insurance & Risk Management leads the design, implementation, and governance of Danone North America's insurance and risk management programs. Reporting directly to Senior Director of Tax and Risk Management for NORAM, with a dotted line to Corporate Director, Global Risk & Insurance in Paris, this role is responsible for safeguarding the organization through effective risk identification, assessment, mitigation, financing, and transfer strategies. The position oversees commercial insurance programs, claims management, broker and insurer relationships, and insurance-related support for strategic initiatives, including acquisitions, divestitures, major capital projects, contractual risk assessments, and other significant business events. The Director partners closely with Legal, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, IT Security, HR, Procurement, Employee Health & Safety, Marketing/Sales, Global Risk teams, and other stakeholders to ensure comprehensive risk oversight and alignment with Danone's global standards. As a key member of our team, you will play an important role in driving our mission forward. The responsibilities below outline the core expectations and contributions for this position. Insurance Strategy & Program Management Develop and execute Danone North America’s insurance strategy, ensuring appropriate protection of company people, assets, operations, and financial strength. Lead the design, placement, administration, and ongoing management of insurance and risk transfer programs across multiple business units. Manage insurance programs including Property; Commercial General Liability / Excess Umbrella; Product Liability; Auto Liability; Workers’ Compensation; Directors & Officers (D&O); Employment Practices Liability (EPL); Fiduciary Liability; Cyber Insurance; Crime/Fidelity; Environmental Impairment Liability; Marine/Cargo; Product Contamination/Recall; and other specialty coverages. Lead local and annual insurance renewals, underwriting submissions, market negotiations, and policy wording reviews; negotiate coverage, pricing, and policy terms with insurers and brokers. Work closely global insurance teams of the parent company to optimize coverage structure, limits, deductibles, and total cost of risk. Develop and manage the insurance budget, including premium projections, retained claims / self-insured fund contributions, and total cost of risk analysis. Analyze market trends and develop renewal strategies that balance risk protection, cost, and business priorities. Operational Risk Management Identify, assess, and prioritize operational and strategic risks with potential insurance, financial, reputational, or business continuity impacts. Support enterprise risk management activities as needed, including risk assessments, risk mitigation planning, and leadership reporting. Promote a risk-management culture and ensure the business involves Insurance & Risk Management in significant events, crises, transactions, projects, and organizational changes. Develop risk policies, insurance-related processes, and claims procedures to support consistent governance across the organization. Claims & Loss Management Oversee major insurance claims, including property, casualty, workers’ compensation, and litigation-related insurance matters. Coordinate with brokers, carriers, legal counsel, business leaders, operational stakeholders, and other relevant partners to support timely claim resolution. Drive loss-prevention initiatives for insurable risks, including property engineering inspections, risk recommendations, and related follow-up actions. Coordinate property risk engineering recommendations and support business continuity and operational risk initiatives. Monitor claims performance and identify opportunities to reduce frequency, severity, and total cost of risk. Contractual Risk Management Review customer, supplier, co-manufacturer, transportation, real estate, commercial, and other third-party agreements for insurance, indemnification, and risk transfer provisions. Advise business partners on risk allocation, contractual protections, indemnification, and insurance requirements. Provide advice to Procurement, Legal, Sales/Marketing, Logistics, and other internal stakeholders during contract negotiations. Cyber & Emerging Risk Oversight Partner with Cyber Security and Digital teams to evaluate cyber risk exposures for insurance renewals and broader risk oversight. Assess evolving regulatory, operational, technological, and emerging risks that may affect Danone North America. Develop insurance and risk solutions for emerging threats in coordination with internal stakeholders and external advisors. Mergers, Acquisitions & Strategic Projects Support acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, integrations, major capital projects, and other strategic initiatives. Conduct insurance and risk due diligence and evaluate transaction-specific liabilities and insurance requirements. Coordinate warranty and indemnity insurance or other transaction-specific insurance solutions when appropriate. Compliance & Governance Ensure compliance with insurance regulations and internal governance standards. Maintain accurate insurance records, certificates, filings, and reporting. Prepare management presentations and reports for leadership and global stakeholders. Support internal and external audits related to insurance and risk management activities. Stakeholder, Broker & Insurer Management Lead relationships with brokers, carriers, insurers, consultants, and third-party vendors. Establish performance expectations and service-level objectives for external partners. Collaborate with global Danone teams to leverage best practices, market intelligence, and global standards. The salary range for this position is $150,000 – $180,000 USD. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone North America additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. To give our employees flexibility, Danone is a hybrid work environment. This role is considered a “hybrid” position that allows for flexible work, meaning it is a role where collaboration with key stakeholders in Danone Hubs occurs. While you may have the option to work from home on a schedule as agreed to with your supervisor, you are also expected to regularly report to your assigned office location at least 3 days per week. About You Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management, Finance, Business, Accounting, Law, Insurance, or a related field required; Master’s degree preferred. Professional insurance designations preferred, such as ARM (Associate in Risk Management) or CPCU; CRM, RIMS-CRMP, or equivalent designation a plus. 10–15 years of progressive insurance and risk management experience in the U.S. and Canada, ideally including experience with global coverages placed outside of the U.S. Experience with a multinational company and multi-cultural environment, preferably in a consumer products company. Demonstrated experience managing multimillion-dollar insurance programs. Strong experience with insurance renewals, policy wording and coverage reviews, claims management, and broker / insurer negotiations. Experience supporting M&A transactions and contractual risk management. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Leadership Strategic thinker capable of balancing risk mitigation with business objectives. Effective communicator with proven ability to build and maintain stakeholder relationships. Strong executive presence and influencing skills. Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across multiple functions and geographies. Deep Insurance & Risk Management Expertise Property & Casualty insurance, Cyber insurance, D&O, Fiduciary and EPL liability, and other financial lines. Environmental Impairment Liability, claims management, risk financing structures, business continuity and crisis management, contractual risk transfer, insurance budget / forecast planning, and property loss control. Business Partnership Strong collaboration skills with internal stakeholders across multiple business units, including Finance, Legal, Operations, HR, IT, Procurement, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Employee Health & Safety, Sales/Marketing, and Logistics leaders. Ability to translate complex risk issues into actionable business recommendations. Analytical Skills Strong quantitative and financial analysis capabilities. Experience evaluating total cost of risk and developing risk mitigation strategies. About Us Life at Danone With approximately 5,000 employees and 13 production locations across the U.S., our vibrant culture and endless growth opportunities are just a couple of the reasons our employees call themselves “Proud Danoners.” Learn more about Life at Danone Our Brands When you join us, you’ll work with some of the best-known food and beverage brands in the world, including Activia®, DanActive®, Danimals®, Dannon®, evian®, Follow Your Heart®, Happy Family® Organics, International Delight®, Light + Fit®, Nutricia ®, Oikos®, Silk®, So Delicious® Dairy Free, STōK® Cold Brew Coffee ®, Too Good & Co™, and YoCrunch®. Our Purpose We’re committed to making a positive impact on our world. Rooted in our mission to bring health through food to as many people as possible, we’re proud to be the world’s largest B Corp. Learn more about our mission. Our Benefits Our commitment to making the world healthier starts with our employees. Physical Wellbeing: We pay for the majority of your medical benefits – which include medical, dental and vision – with our competitive 80%/20% cost-sharing model. Mental Wellbeing: Danoners receive fitness discounts, unlimited flexible time off and hybrid work schedules. We also have a range of programs that support mental health and substance abuse. Financial Support: We offer a performance-based bonus, a 401(k) plan, tuition reimbursement, employee discount programs and voluntary perks. Family Care: We offer caretaker benefits, 18 weeks of parental bonding, fertility, surrogacy, adoption benefits and pet insurance. Learn more about our benefits. Equal Opportunity Employer Danone North America is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. It is our policy to give equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to legally protected characteristics, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state/provincial and/or local law. For our EEO policy statement and your EEO rights under law click here. #LI-NORAM #LI-HYBRID #LI-SM1 California Data Privacy Law About You

jobs.title: Human Resources Manager
jobs.description: About the Job At Danone, manufacturing the best products and supplying them to meet demand is a key driver for our plant teams. We are currently looking to hire a Human Resources Manager based in our manufacturing plant in Dubois, Pennsylvania! The Human Resources Manager is a key HR leader for the manufacturing site and an important member of the Plant Leadership team. This role serves as a strategic partner to plant leadership while acting as a visible, trusted point of contact for associates across the site. The HR Manager leads all aspects of Human Resources at the plant, including labor and employee relations, talent strategy, workforce planning, culture and engagement, compliance, and organizational capability building. This leader plays a critical role in enabling Danone’s manufacturing transformation by supporting the adoption of disciplined ways of working and fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement. This DuBois, PA–based role serves as the primary HR leader for the DuBois, PA manufacturing site. The role leads a team of one HR Coordinator. Our DuBois plant is a union facility comprised of approximately 125 team members and three production lines manufacturing plant-based products under the Silk and So Delicious brands. Key Responsibilities As a key member of our team, you will play an important role in driving our mission forward. The following responsibilities outline the core expectations and contributions for this position: Strategic People Leadership Serve as a key member of the Plant Leadership Team, partnering with leaders to develop and execute a long-term people strategy aligned to business priorities Champion Danone’s culture, values, and behaviors, creating an inclusive, engaging, and high-performance work environment. Lead site wide engagement and listening efforts, translating feedback into clear actions that improve employee experience and business results. Employee & Labor Relations Lead employee and labor relations matters, including investigations, grievances, and conflict resolution, ensuring fair, consistent, and compliant outcomes Build and maintain strong, productive relationships with union representatives (where applicable) and plant stakeholders. Coach leaders to strengthen frontline leadership capability and reduce risk through effective people management. Talent, Capability & Organization Own workforce planning, staffing strategy, succession planning, and leadership development for the plant. Lead, coach, and develop HR team, setting clear expectations and building capability across all HR disciplines. Partner with leaders to build organizational capability and support change initiatives. Change & Continuous Improvement Support the people and change management aspects of Danone’s manufacturing operating system and continuous improvement initiatives. Enable disciplined routines, standard work, and leadership behaviors that support sustainable adoption of new ways of working. Use people data and metrics to identify trends, measure progress, and drive targeted improvement actions. HR Operations & Compliance Ensure compliance with labor and employment law, company policies, and HR processes. Maintain accurate HR data and support reporting/analytics. Partner with centers of excellence (COEs). Physical Demands This role requires the ability to perform essential job functions, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the Plant HR Manager is regularly required to: Stand, walk, and move throughout the manufacturing facility, including production, warehouse, office, and outdoor areas, for extended periods of time Sit intermittently to perform administrative, planning, and reporting functions Use hands and fingers to operate computers, phones, office equipment, and other standard business tools Reach with hands and arms and occasionally bend, stoop, or crouch while observing operations or engaging employees on the production floor Must be able to travel occasionally to manufacturing sites, corporate offices or offsite meetings as business needs require. The Plant HR Manager may occasionally be required to lift and/or move materials such as files, training materials, personal protective equipment, or office supplies. Lifting is generally limited and incidental to the role and does not involve continuous or production level of physical exertion. Specific sensory abilities required include: Vision, with or without correction, sufficient to review documents, observe working conditions, and monitor compliance Hearing, with or without correction, sufficient to communicate effectively with employees and leaders in both office and manufacturing environments This role requires standing for extended periods and lifting up to 25 lbs. Work Environment This position is based primarily in a manufacturing plant environment and requires regular presence on the production floor. The employee may be exposed to moderate noise, moving mechanical parts, and temperature variations Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) is required when accessing designated areas of the facility. Work schedules could include nights, weekends and/or holidays to provide the ability to support a 24/7 or a 24/5 manufacturing environment as business needs dictate. Engagement in our Integrated Work Systems Ensure adherence to all plant standards and procedures (including but not limited to GMP, AIB, FDA, Quality, Safety, Finance, ISO, HOPE, Danone Behaviors, Daily Direction Setting, and Driving OE). As a fundamental leader within the organization, own the implementation and deployment of the Integrated Work Systems (IWS) framework or equivalent continuous improvement systems across all plant types. This includes driving core pillars such as Leadership Foundation, Daily Direction Setting, Driving Operational Excellence, Autonomous and Planned Maintenance, Focused Improvement, Education and Training, Environmental Health and Safety, Quality, and Supply Network. The objective is to build a culture of ownership of space, performance (Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Mobilization, Nature), and continuous improvement regardless of system maturity. Compensation & Benefits: The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone North America additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. To give our employees flexibility, Danone is a hybrid work environment. About You The ideal candidate will bring a combination of education, experience, and skills that enable them to excel in this position. The following qualifications outline what we’re looking for, including both required and preferred criteria: Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (required). A master’s degree and/or SPHR/SHRM-SCP certifications are preferred. A minimum of 5+ years of progressive HR experience required. At least 3 years union/labor relations experience within a manufacturing / industrial / supply chain environment, required. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities: Computer proficiency in MS Office products (including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Power Point), required. Experience with Ceridian Dayforce is a plus. Strong working knowledge of HR fundamentals, compliance, and employment law, policies and processes. Strong leadership and team development capabilities. Get a great taste of life in “FMCG” (aka “fast moving consumer goods”, or in human language: brands and products you can find when exploring your local supermarket) in a dynamic, enthusiastic and incredibly talented team (maybe we should add humble too?). Oh well, all joking aside: you may just have found your dream job! Hungry to apply? Let’s go! In this role, you will be driving the growth of Plant-Based & Alpro through developing and executing effective marketing strategies. You will be part of the Plant-Based Marketing Benelux team, together with team of (Sr) Brand Managers and will be reporting directly into the Plant-Based Marketing Director. Your key responsibilities are: From a strategic perspective, you will be responsible to create annual growth strategy and brand plans for BeNeLux on your category scope: plantbased yoghurts (PBY). This includes: Design of the brand plans for Belgium and Netherlands in close collaboration with cross departments (sales, finance, catman, shopper, RGM, media, Strategic & insights team…). Delivering clear “jobs to be done” and priorities, on all that relates to our Alpro plantbased yoghurt in Alpro. You own and deliver significant elements of the annual category and brand planning process: from proactively identifying gaps/opportunities & following closely business results, through to presentation sign-off and sales presentations, together with your team. Your business skills, retail knowledge, strategic and growth mindset are essential in that role. From a Portfolio & Inno/Reno perspective, you will lead portfolio strategy and co-lead the plant-based inno/reno projects with project management team and your team. This includes: Portfolio management including innovations, renovations falling under the PBY category for the alpro brand: You work with your key stakeholders to deliver the annual sales and business objectives, across the company’s main product categories and innovations. Together with CatMan you manage the portfolio priorities and define the national assortment cards. Working hand in hand with the European portfolio team, you voice the local BeNelux needs and align to build the ideal portfolio pipeline. New Product Development launches & post-launches: You lead the category and product planning process for your market. Delivering the right innovation and renovation projects on time, in full, at target. You work closely together with the global plant-based acceleration unit and IPRO team to ensure full and timely delivery of inno and reno project. You work together with Category Management to build the consumer, sales and business cases to back-up proposed solutions. You work with PRGM/Finance to deliver clear P&L’s for each proposed inno/reno – focusing on growing topline and bottom-line. You regularly present and advocate plans to other functional teams and commercial contacts. You proactively manage feedback within those conversations. You rollout launch(es), with and together with your sales and category colleagues. Together with category management, you set clear KPI’s for each innovation and track these and the total performance in market, assess ROI at post-launch review and advise changes where necessary. From an Equity, Brand & Activation perspective, you will be responsible for your own Growth Events & Equity platforms. This will include: Brand Campaigns and Activation: You are responsible to set up engaging 360 campaigns promoting the Alpro brand & key growth platforms ATL & BTL You co-create the Growth Event calendar reflecting on local excellence in execution through strategic collaboration with our creative & media agency. You collaborate with the media team BE/NL & agencies to design full offline & online marketing campaigns with good campaign & media brief and co-own community / influencer management. You feed into the objective of each campaign & KPI’s to measure post campaign performance (from both media & brand perspective). You monitor the campaign analysis: closely monitor our campaigns, collect market & consumer insights, followed by implementing our learnings and continuously optimizing our campaigns. You provide thought leadership to the team by connecting marketing mix elements and materials, ensuring best-in-class execution. You feed into the shopper team: giving input on hero products for the growth events, building strong inter-connection to ensure in-store excellence. From a stakeholder and leadership perspective, as owner of the local Alpro PBY portfolio, you liaise with the right stakeholders to ensure timely and on target delivery of the business objectives. You work closely together with key global & EU stakeholder. You work together with key local stakeholders to fully leverage the power of our brand and category: KAMs, Cat Man, R&I, S&I, IPRO, Field D2D-team, Finance. You report into the Plant-based Marketing Director. Making sure they have the right information available to validate business, portfolio & equity decisions and push the local agenda within the local business team. You leverage your leadership & team engagement to further develop the capabilities within the team and your N-1(s). About You To be successful in this role, you: Have significant marketing experience (8+ years), ideally within FMCG, with ownership of brands, categories, or portfolios. Excel in developing brand and category strategies, translating annual operating plans (AOP) into impactful tactics that strengthen brand equity and drive demand. Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across functions, partnering with Sales, R&I, S&I, Category Management, Finance and other key stakeholders to deliver business objectives. Demonstrate strong leadership in innovation, renovation and communication projects, managing initiatives both locally and across European markets. Successfully manage integrated marketing campaigns, leading projects from insight and ideation through execution and performance evaluation across multiple channels. Combine strategic thinking with creativity, feeling comfortable building business cases with limited data and finding solutions to complex business challenges. Have strong analytical skills, including experience working with Nielsen, GfK and other market, consumer and performance data sources. Manage budgets effectively, including annual planning, investment allocation, performance tracking and ROI analysis. Show a proactive, entrepreneurial mindset, working independently, adapting to change and continuously seeking opportunities to learn and improve. Are passionate about the plant-based category and inspired by brands that contribute positively to health, people and the planet. Are fluent in Dutch and English; French is considered an advantage. Hold a Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, Economics, Digital Marketing or a related field (or an equivalent Bachelor's degree with relevant experience). jobs.title: Manager, Indirect Procurement (Nutricia + Kate Farms)
jobs.description: About the Job As a Manager, Indirect Procurement, you will play a critical role in enabling business performance through the development and execution of strategic sourcing initiatives across key indirect spend categories. You will lead category strategies, supplier relationships, negotiations, and cross-functional initiatives that deliver sustainable value, drive innovation, mitigate risk, and support Danone's long-term growth ambitions. Partnering closely with Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, IT, Marketing, Legal, and Sustainability teams, you will ensure procurement remains a strategic business partner across the organization. The successful candidate will balance cost, quality, service, innovation, and sustainability objectives while building strong stakeholder alignment throughout North America. Key Responsibilities Category Strategy & Leadership Develop and implement procurement strategies for assigned indirect categories across North America. Build and maintain category roadmaps aligned with business priorities and organizational goals. Conduct spend analysis, market intelligence assessments, and supplier benchmarking to identify opportunities and risks. Establish and execute sourcing strategies that improve profitability, resilience, and operational effectiveness. Drive Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) optimization across category portfolios. Strategic Sourcing & Negotiations Lead RFx activities including RFI, RFP, RFQ, supplier selection, and contract negotiations. Negotiate commercial agreements, pricing structures, service levels, and contract terms. Deliver annual productivity, cost savings, and value creation targets. Ensure sourcing decisions align with procurement governance and compliance standards. Collaborate with legal teams to manage contract lifecycle activities and mitigate commercial risk. Supplier Relationship Management Build strategic partnerships with key suppliers to improve performance, innovation, sustainability, and service delivery. Establish supplier performance scorecards and business review processes. Identify and develop alternative suppliers to improve competitive positioning and supply security. Drive supplier-led innovation opportunities that support business growth and operational excellence. Stakeholder Management Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders and functional stakeholders. Partner with Operations, Manufacturing, Engineering, Finance, Human Resources, Marketing, Information Technology, and Supply Chain teams to understand evolving business needs. Facilitate alignment between category strategies and business objectives. Lead cross-functional sourcing projects from opportunity identification through implementation. Physical Demands & Work Environment This role is primarily performed in a remote office setting and requires the ability to remain in a stationary position (e.g., seated or standing) for extended periods. The employee may be required to travel to Danone corporate offices and vendor sites as needed. The salary range for this position is $76,000-126,000 USD. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone USA additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. To give our employees flexibility, Danone is a hybrid work environment. About You The ideal candidate will bring a combination of education, experience, and skills that enable them to excel in this position. The following qualifications outline what we’re looking for, including both required and preferred criteria: Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Engineering, or related field. MBA, Master's degree, CPSM, CIPS, or equivalent professional certification preferred. 8+ years of progressive procurement, strategic sourcing, or category management experience. Experience managing complex indirect spend categories within a multinational organization. Proven track record delivering measurable cost savings, productivity improvements, and supplier performance enhancements. Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders. FMCG, food and beverage, manufacturing, consumer packaged goods, or industrial experience preferred. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Strategic sourcing and category management expertise. Advanced negotiation and contract management skills. Supplier relationship management experience. Strong financial acumen and analytical capabilities. Spend analysis and procurement analytics. Knowledge of procurement systems such as SAP, Coupa, or similar platforms. Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills. About Us Danone North America Medical Nutrition brings together a growing portfolio of mission-driven brands, including Kate Farms, Nutricia, Neocate, Pepticate, Functional Formularies, and Real Food Blends. Together, we deliver science-backed nutrition solutions for infants, children, and adults with complex nutritional needs, whether they consume nutrition orally or through a feeding tube. Our ambition is clear: to improve health outcomes, expand access to high-quality nutrition, help reduce healthcare costs, and build sustainable growth. We combine trusted, consumer-loved brands with strong scientific and medical expertise to create nutrition solutions that make a meaningful difference in people’s lives. By joining our approximately 450-person North America Medical Nutrition organization, you will become part of Danone’s broader North American and global network. You will have the opportunity to contribute to a growing business, collaborate across brands and functions, and help shape the future of medical nutrition in the US. You will also join one of the world’s largest Certified B Corporations, working for a company committed to creating lasting value for people and the planet. Danone North America is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Demonstrated experience leading employee relations, labor relations, performance management, investigations, and organizational change, required. Experience partnering with plant leadership teams and operating in a fast-paced, 24/7 manufacturing environment strongly preferred. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities: Strong knowledge of labor relations, employee relations, HR fundamentals, employment law, and compliant HR practices. jobs.title: M&A Intern (Jan - Jul 2027)

Over recent years, Danone has been highly active in M&A and portfolio management, executing a robust pipeline of acquisitions and disposals across geographies and categories. Transactions span a wide range of deal sizes and strategic rationales, providing broad exposure to real world corporate finance, valuation, and strategy topics. The team is organized into two regional hubs: • Paris, covering EMEA & the Americas • Singapore and Bangkok, covering APAC Operating at the intersection of strategy and finance, the M&A Team is involved throughout the full transaction lifecycle—from strategic assessment and valuation to execution and closing. As an M&A intern, you will join a highly driven and international team, gaining hands on exposure to live transactions and portfolio initiatives. You will work closely with senior team members and external advisors, developing strong analytical, financial modelling, and strategic thinking skills in a fast paced, high impact environment. About You Monitor M&A and sector developments across the region, proactively identifying potential acquisition or divestment targets and building / updating company profiles (business overview, strategic fit, financials, ownership, valuation, etc.) Contribute to monthly regional M&A review materials presented to senior management, including market activity summaries, pipeline tracking, and transaction status updates Support the execution of live M&A transactions across the full deal lifecycle, with responsibilities including: o Financial analysis and valuation work (trading comparables, transaction comparables, DCF support) o Financial modelling support for investment cases and scenario analyses o Preparation of M&A memos, management presentations, and internal decision materials o Coordination with internal stakeholders and external advisors Undertake ad hoc strategic and analytical projects related to portfolio management, business case assessments, and transaction preparation, depending on deal flow and priorities About Us Focus on development – your way With a suite of learning opportunities and a strong focus on in-role development, your line manager will work closely with you to help unlock your career ambitions within Danone. Working here you will enjoy a fast-paced, complex environment, which is packed with opportunities for the entrepreneurial spirit. You’ll work with some of the best-known brands in the world, such as evian, Dumex and Aptamil, and we absolutely guarantee that you can just be yourself. P is for Proximity, as we believe that building close relationships leads to better understanding and trust. E is for Enthusiasm, for those who are as passionate as we are about bringing health through food to as many people as possible. Diversity and Inclusion (D&I) is deeply embedded in Danone's DNA, representing our core values and beliefs. We embrace diversity as a driving force for positive change, nurturing an inclusive workplace where every individual is valued. Join our movement for a healthier world. One Planet One Health BY YOU. For more information about Danone, our divisions and culture, please visit careers.danone.com. #LI-DPS

jobs.title: Assistant Brand Manager
jobs.description: About The Job Assistant Brand Manager（アシスタント・ブランドマネージャー）として、ブランド戦略の実行を支援し、事業成長と市場シェアの拡大を推進するうえで重要な役割を担います。クロスファンクショナルなチームと緊密に連携しながら、当社のブランドポートフォリオが効果的に管理・運営されるようサポートしていただきます。 ＜ビジネス・市場分析（Business & Market Analysis）＞ 売上、市場、消費者、競合に関するデータを分析し、重要なトレンド、インサイト、および事業機会を特定する。 ブランドおよびポートフォリオの業績に影響を与える成長要因と阻害要因を深く理解する。 消費者、競合他社、および流通チャネルの動向を継続的にモニタリングし、ギャップ、リスク、成長機会を先回りして特定する。 ブランド力の向上と事業目標の達成を支援するために、実行可能な提言・推奨策を策定する。 ＜ブランド成長・イノベーション（Brand Growth & Innovation）＞ 持続的な成長を実現するためのブランド戦略の立案および実行を支援する。 製品の維持・改良・ライン拡張を通じて既存ポートフォリオを管理・強化するとともに、新たな製品やコンセプトの開発機会を特定する。 消費者ニーズや市場機会に対応したイノベーションパイプラインおよび製品ローンチ計画の策定に貢献する。 デジタルプラットフォームを含む適切なチャネルにおいて、認知拡大、試用促進、エンゲージメント向上、およびブランド価値の強化につながる効果的なマーケティング施策を企画・実行する。 ＜クロスファンクショナルな実行（Cross-Functional Execution）＞ 営業、トレードマーケティング、サプライチェーン、財務、消費者インサイト部門、および外部エージェンシーなどの関連部門と効果的に連携し、ブランド目標の達成に貢献する。 店頭およびデジタル施策を含むあらゆる顧客接点において、マーケティング施策、プロモーション活動、およびサポートプランを高い品質で実行する。 各施策の効果を追跡・評価し、パフォーマンスの最適化と投資対効果（ROI）の最大化に向けて改善提案や必要な調整を行う。 市場やキャンペーンの成果から得られた学び、ベストプラクティス、およびインサイトを共有し、継続的な改善活動を推進する。 About You 学歴 学士号またはそれに準ずる学位を有すること （マーケティング、経営学、コミュニケーション学専攻が望ましい） 必須スキル、経験 ＜プロジェクトサポート＞ 役割 ブランド施策や新製品導入プロジェクトの円滑な実行に向けて、プロジェクトマネジメントにおいて重要なサポートを提供し、必要に応じてリード役を担う。 協働 クロスファンクショナルなチームと密接に連携し、プロジェクト目標の達成を推進する。 ＜新製品導入（New Launch Initiatives）＞ 企画・実行 新製品またはリニューアル製品の発売計画の立案および実行を支援する。 貢献 スピード感のある製品ローンチスケジュールの中で学びながら積極的に貢献する。 ＜ブランドの統合的管理（Brand Holistic Management）＞ サポート マーケティングマネージャーを支援し、ブランド全体を包括的な視点で管理する。 貢献 主力SKU（主要製品）のリニューアル、維持管理、および販促・活性化施策の企画立案に貢献する。 ＜ブランドマーケティング経験＞ 経験 ブランドマーケティング分野で2～5年程度の実務経験を有すること。 FMCG（消費財）業界での経験があれば尚可。 責任範囲 ブランド損益（P&L）の一部を担当した経験を有することが望ましい。 ＜語学力＞ 日本語 日本語話者の社内外ステークホルダーと円滑にコミュニケーションを図るため、ネイティブレベルの日本語力を有すること。 英語 必要に応じて、ビジネスレベルの英語による読み書きおよび会話ができること。 求める人物像 1. 目標達成への強い意欲（Passion to Win） 高い目標を設定し、それを上回る成果を追求する強い意欲と実行力を持つ。 2. 起業家精神（Entrepreneurial Mindset） 自ら主体的に行動し、複数の業務を同時に管理・推進できる。 3. 創造性とチャレンジ精神（Creativity and Risk-Taking） 豊かな発想力を持ち、新しいことに積極的に挑戦し、適切なリスクを取る姿勢を有する。 4. 学習敏捷性（Quick Learner） マーケティング分野での成長に強い意欲を持ち、新しい知識やスキルを素早く習得して業務に活かせる。 About jobs.title: IT&Data Senior Product Analyst - Total Rewards
jobs.description: About The Job As Senior Product Analyst for Total Rewards, you act as the technical expert and solution reference for the product team. You advise the Product Owner and delivery team on SAP SuccessFactors Rewards capabilities, configuration options, technical impacts, data implications and risks. You also lead external benchmarking, monitor SAP innovations and market practices, and translate relevant best practices into scalable, maintainable solution recommendations for the product scope. You ensure that validated Rewards business needs are translated into robust, scalable and maintainable solution designs, while advising the Product Owner on technical feasibility, risks and trade-offs. You anticipate configuration impacts across Rewards campaigns, strengthen the internal technical expertise of the ITHR Rewards team and ensure that external benchmarks and best practices inform product improvement decisions. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES SAP SuccessFactors Rewards Technical Leadership - Serve as the main technical reference for SAP SuccessFactors Rewards capabilities within the product team - Assess configuration options and recommend solutions that are scalable, standard, maintainable and aligned with SAP SuccessFactors best practices and external benchmarks - Anticipate configuration impacts, dependencies, data implications, integration risks and operational consequences across the HRIS ecosystem - Challenge overly complex, customized or unsustainable requests and propose pragmatic alternatives Solution Design and Technical Advisory - Translate validated Rewards business needs into high-level solution approaches, design principles and configuration recommendations - Support the Product Owner in understanding feasibility, complexity, risks and trade-offs before prioritization decisions are made - Review major functional and technical specifications to ensure consistency with product principles and system sustainability - Provide technical guidance to the Product Analyst, consultants, Chapter members and other delivery contributors, define the scope of delegated configuration and data administration activities, and review or approve higher-risk changes when required Campaign Technical Readiness - Anticipate technical readiness needs for large-scale Performance and Rewards campaigns, including Performance assessment, Performance calibrations, Annual Salary Review, Short Term Incentives and Long Term Incentives - Identify risks related to eligibility rules, templates, data flows, integrations and downstream dependencies - Ensure that technical assumptions, configuration decisions and campaign-specific constraints are clearly documented before execution - Support critical issue analysis during campaign preparation, execution and post-go-live stabilization Backlog Readiness and Story Quality - Ensure that stories are technically mature before entering delivery, with clear dependencies, acceptance criteria, configuration assumptions and risks - Support backlog refinement by clarifying technical impacts, feasibility and sequencing options - Help split complex requests into deliverable stories without taking over backlog prioritization from the Product Owner - Prepare technical handover inputs for the Product Analyst, consultants and Chapter members Technical Governance and Knowledge Building - Contribute to technical governance by documenting design decisions, configuration rationale and lessons learned - Build and maintain internal knowledge on SAP SuccessFactors Rewards modules and configuration principles - Monitor relevant SAP SuccessFactors innovations, releases and best-practice evolutions and assess their relevance for the product scope - Coach the Product Analyst on configuration logic, technical follow-up and quality expectations About You We expect you to have: Minimum 5 years of experience in HRIS, SAP SuccessFactors, Rewards, compensation processes or related HR technology environments Strong experience with configuration principles, solution design, technical impact assessment and HRIS dependencies Experience supporting complex Rewards campaigns or compensation cycles in an international environment is strongly preferred Skills: Advanced knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors Rewards capabilities, ideally including Compensation and Variable Pay configuration principles Ability to anticipate configuration impacts and recommend best-practice solution options Ability to define technical guardrails, assess the risk level of configuration and data administration changes, and provide effective guidance, review and approval for delegated system interventions. Strong analytical mindset, technical curiosity and ability to challenge solution complexity constructively Clear communication with both technical contributors and non-technical stakeholders Good understanding of Agile delivery, backlog refinement and story readiness About Us At the Danone group we are fulfilling our mission, according to which „we bring health to as many people as possible”. Behind our brands is always technology pushing them forward. We know that the future of business is IT and data. That’s why we use advanced and innovative IT solutions which are implemented in all Danone units around the world. For more information about Danone, our divisions and culture, please explore https://careers.danone.com WE OFFER A revolutionary job that will be part of the digital transformation of global FMCG leader. We consider that it starts with people who notice more and make better decisions. And that’s exactly the kind of people we want to attract to DANONE. We know that the future of business is IT and data. We are looking for catalysts for change. We ensure you work with great products, and technologies in an international environment, learning from experts and experienced managers but how much you will develop in this position depends on you! We value smart working so that’s why while being focused on results, we offer flexible working hours and a home office policy. You are able to work from the office in Warsaw twice a week. Want to move to Warsaw? OK! We have a relocation package to help you out! On top of that, you will have access to the benefits we offer to you and your family, including private medical care, benefits package for parents, life insurance, social fund, or employee discounts. We’ve always been changers. WHAT NEXT? Click the “Apply” button and create your profile in the recruitment system by uploading a CV. We will get acquainted with your experience and then we will arrange the selected candidates for the first telephone interview. Next steps are two meetings with your future managers at Danone. Do not hesitate and join our IT&DATA Team in Poland which vision is that the technology is a strategic differentiator for DANONE, powered by an IT agile organization. jobs.title: Internship (Marketing): Brand Management Oikos & Danio
jobs.description: About The Job Looking for a hands-on marketing internship where you can combine business performance analysis with creative brand execution? Join our Dairy Marketing team and discover what Brand Management looks like in a leading FMCG company, from performance tracking and media campaigns to innovation and renovation projects. About the Job You will become part of Danone's Benelux Dairy Marketing team, contributing to the growth and positioning of strong dairy brands such as Oikos and Danio. As a Brand Management Intern, you will support the Brand Managers on key marketing projects while also taking ownership of your own initiatives. This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in Brand Management within a leading FMCG company. You will contribute to a wide range of projects, from analyzing business performance and consumer trends to supporting media campaigns, adapting creative assets, coordinating product renovations and contributing to innovation initiatives, while seeing the direct impact of your work in the marketplace. Your responsibilities may include: Monitoring business and brand performance, preparing monthly updates and translating key insights into clear recommendations; Analyzing market, category and consumer data to support business and marketing decisions; Supporting innovation and renovation projects, including product launches, portfolio updates and go-to-market preparation; Supporting media campaigns, including creative adaptation, influencer marketing, asset creation and campaign follow-up with media and creative agencies; Conducting and interpreting market research and consumer insights; Coordinating packaging changes, including graphic chain briefs and follow-up; Creating, adapting and coordinating brand, in-store and communication materials for local market needs; Working closely with internal stakeholders and external agencies. About You We are looking for an enthusiastic, resilient and eager‑to‑learn intern who enjoys working in a dynamic marketing environment. You: Have a strong interest in marketing and brand management; Are curious and analytical, and enjoy using numbers, performance reports and consumer insights to support marketing decisions; Can translate data and insights into clear recommendations, while also bringing a hands-on mindset to brand, media and project work; Are fluent in English and Dutch (French is a plus); Are hands-on, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership and responsibility; Are able to manage and switch between multiple projects effectively; Have strong communication skills and can present complex information in a clear and structured way; Are able to work both independently and as part of a team. Practical requirements: You are available to start in January 2027; The internship lasts 6 months, 5 days per week; You are willing to work 1–2 days per week from the office (Brussels) Own your journey. From how you learn and grow to the impact you make, this internship is an opportunity to shape your experience and accelerate your development! About Us Working here you’ll need to enjoy a fast-pace, complexity and it can get a little challenging. But it’s packed with opportunities. Be innovative and entrepreneurial and the impact you could make might just amaze you. Join our movement for a healthier world. One Planet One Health BY YOU. We are proud to be an equal employer. We are convinced our differences make the difference and that an inclusive working environment will drive our growth as a business, as teams and as individuals. We Offer A unique learning experience inside a dynamic, ever-evolving multinational, where you will gain hands-on experience in Brand Management and work on well-known brands such as Oikos and Danio. Proactivity, empowerment, and diversity are the basis of Danone culture. Through supporting the Sales Team, you will be working closely with your colleagues as one young and agile multi-disciplinary team, where everyone plays a key role. Personal and professional growth, supported by autonomy, flexibility and meaningful responsibilities. Throughout your internship, you will develop project management skills, learn how marketing strategies are developed and executed, and gain exposure to real business challenges. A collaborative environment with flat hierarchies and inclusive teams where every voice counts, guided by our core values: Humanism, Openness, Proximity and Enthusiasm. You will collaborate with experienced professionals and contribute to projects with tangible impact. A strong foundation for your future career, helping you build practical experience in Brand Management, strengthen your analytical skills and develop expertise within the FMCG industry. Across areas such as innovation, product superiority but also minimising our impact. Continuous Improvement & Transformation Lead CI initiatives across procurement (Lean, Kaizen, root‑cause analysis). Drive simplification: “keep it simple” mindset across tools, workflows, templates. jobs.title: Chief of Staff - Director, R&I - Strategic Planning and Performance
jobs.description: About the Job This is a pivotal leadership role designed to propel key initiatives forward and accelerate the Research & Innovation (R&I) organization toward its future vision. The Chief of Staff will act as a strategic partner to the CRIO and the Executive team, elevating the effectiveness of R&I leadership for the benefit of the broader business. This position requires a highly resourceful individual with strong emotional intelligence, analytical rigor, and the ability to stay several steps ahead of the executive team. Core Responsibilities Strategic Planning & Performance Management Annual & Long-Term Planning: Lead the annual and long-term strategic planning process to align with broader enterprise strategies. Performance Dashboards: Partner with the data science team to build automated, consistent dashboards that track R&I performance measures and critical metrics. Data Validation: Identify and validate data sources in partnership with key leaders to ensure accuracy in exception reporting and trend analysis. Decision Support: Develop measures to add rigor to decision-making, helping leaders determine where R&I should spend time for the greatest impact. Executive Advisory & Representation Right-Hand Advisor: Serve as a confidant and sounding board for the CRIO, offering objective, enterprise-wide perspectives without specific "turf" considerations. Executive Representation: Represent the CRIO in critical meetings, articulating their viewpoints and decisions while managing their agenda to maximize efficiency. Succession & Objectives: Advise the Head of R&I and project manage annual objectives to ensure all groups within the organization are successful. Governance & Operating Model Leadership Forums: Drive agendas and content for R&I Leadership Team (LT) meetings and Townhalls, ensuring a focus on both strategic priorities and tactical updates. Meeting Management: Facilitate team communication, manage follow-ups on project metrics, and partner with EA support to maintain an accessible framework for prep materials and minutes. Way of Working: Implement standards for the division, such as email protocols (e.g., clear subject lines like "Decision Needed" or "Seeking Approval") to facilitate faster information assimilation. Prioritization: Challenge the leadership group on "go vs. no-go" initiatives, tracking deferred projects for future consideration. Communications & Engagement Strategic Framework: Develop a communications cadence for engaging the broader team through town halls, recorded videos, and site visits. Executive Presence: Consolidate weekly reporting for the executive committee and partner with the CRIO on quarterly board documents and external communications. Culture & Engagement: Assess employee engagement survey results and sponsor action teams to drive meaningful change in organizational culture. Strategic Transformation & Catalytic Leadership Agile Innovation Catalyst: Drive a cultural shift toward agile innovation and experimentation, championing a "test & learn/fail fast" mentality to accelerate speed-to-market. Organizational Transformation: Lead one or more high-priority strategic projects in direct partnership with senior leadership to fundamentally transform organizational capabilities. Cross-Functional Leadership: Work across the North America R&I Leadership team by partnering with other function leads towards the seamless execution of key organizational goals and collective success. Best-in-Class Talent Development: Create a superior team of associates by modeling and coaching high-level leadership behaviors and setting modern standards for excellence. Cross-Technical Synergy: Strengthen cross-technical collaboration and knowledge sharing to break down silos and leverage the full scale of the North America R&I expertise. Strategic Influence: Act as a change agent to influence and strengthen the R&I teams, ensuring the division is viewed as a high-impact, indispensable driver of enterprise growth. Success Factors Professionalism: High level of executive presence, professionalism, and absolute respect for confidentiality. Analytical Thinking: Ability to rapidly assimilate complex data and present it in a consumable, articulated form. Collaboration: Strong alignment with data science, business operations, and leadership teams across the global and local organization. Adaptability: Proficiency in navigating fast-paced, complex environments while maintaining extreme attention to detail. The salary range for this position is $149,000-214,000 USD. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone North America additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. To give our employees flexibility, Danone is a hybrid work environment. This role is considered a “hybrid” position that allows for flexible work, meaning it is a role where collaboration with key stakeholders in Danone Hubs occurs. While you may have the option to work from home on a schedule as agreed to with your supervisor, you are also expected to regularly report to your assigned office location at least 3 days per week. About You Qualifications: Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Business or related degrees; advanced degree preferred. Professional Experience: Minimum of 10 years of leadership experience, ideally within a large consumer packaged goods company or consulting firm. Prior management consulting, internal consulting, or advisory experience with demonstrated success solving complex business challenges and influencing stakeholders strongly preferred. Strategic Collaboration: Proven ability to serve as a strategic partner to senior leadership, with experience in strategic workforce planning, performance management frameworks, and the development of metrics to measure business impact and drive data-informed decision making. Analytical Thinker: Ability to rapidly assimilate vital information and articulate appropriate responses in both written and oral communication. Dynamic Environment: Proficiency in navigating complex, fast-paced environments and coordinating with numerous stakeholders. Stakeholder Management: Demonstrable emotional intelligence and the ability to foster relationships within large organizations. Adaptability: Ability to acclimate to varying environments and effectively engage with individuals across all hierarchical levels. Project Management: Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with a keen attention to detail. About Us Life at Danone With approximately 5,000 employees and 13 production locations across the U.S., our vibrant culture and endless growth opportunities are just a couple of the reasons our employees call themselves “Proud Danoners.” Learn more about Life at Danone Our Brands When you join us, you’ll work with some of the best-known food and beverage brands in the world, including Activia®, DanActive®, Danimals®, Dannon®, evian®, Follow Your Heart®, Happy Family® Organics, International Delight®, Light + Fit®, Nutricia ®, Oikos®, Silk®, So Delicious® Dairy Free, STōK® Cold Brew Coffee ®, Too Good & Co™, and YoCrunch®. Our Purpose We’re committed to making a positive impact on our world. Rooted in our mission to bring health through food to as many people as possible, we’re proud to be the world’s largest B Corp. Learn more about our mission. Our Benefits Our commitment to making the world healthier starts with our employees. Physical Wellbeing: We pay for the majority of your medical benefits – which include medical, dental and vision – with our competitive 80%/20% cost-sharing model. Mental Wellbeing: Danoners receive fitness discounts, unlimited flexible time off and hybrid work schedules. We also have a range of programs that support mental health and substance abuse. Financial Support: We offer a performance-based bonus, a 401(k) plan, tuition reimbursement, employee discount programs and voluntary perks. Family Care: We offer caretaker benefits, 18 weeks of parental bonding, fertility, surrogacy, adoption benefits and pet insurance. Learn more about our benefits. jobs.title: Operations Director
jobs.description: About the Job At Danone, Manufacturing the best products and supplying them to meet demand is a key driver for our plant teams. We are currently looking to hire an Operations Director based in Dallas, Texas. The Operations Director will strategically manage manufacturing operations at our state-of-the-art, extra-large beverage production facility. This role partners closely with the Plant Director to oversee all daily production activities, directly manage business unit leaders and drive strategic initiatives, while also fostering a culture of continuous improvement and safety. This role is responsible for ensuring customer orders are produced timely in a cost-effective manner with safety and quality as top priorities. Key Responsibilities Lead short- and medium-term production strategies to optimize labor, materials, and workflows. Drive accountability and cultural change through Danone’s Integrated Work Systems (IWS). Monitor and improve SQCDMN metrics (Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Mobilization, Nature). Provide administrative direction across departments including Production, Packaging, Processing, Planning, and Purchasing. Manage operational budgets, cost controls, and profit/loss statements. Partner with HR in a union environment on hiring, performance, and employee relations. Oversee capital project planning and execution. Ensure compliance with GMP, FDA, safety, and food quality standards. Foster a collaborative, ethical, and high-performance culture across teams. Physical Demands The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential function of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs and ladders, balance; stoop, kneel or crouch; talk and hear. Occasionally required to lift and / or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Work Environment The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee regularly works near moving mechanical parts and is regularly exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee may be exposed to fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals and may be exposed to loud noises in the plant. The employee occasionally works in high, precarious places and is occasionally exposed to extreme cold, risk of electrical shock and vibration. Engagement in our Integrated Work Systems Ensure adherence to plant standards (including but not limited to GMP, AIB, FDA, Quality, Safety, Finance, ISO, Daily Direction Setting, Driving Operational Efficiency). As a fundamental piece of the organization, your responsibility is to participate and own the implementation and deployment of related integrated work systems and corresponding pillars (Leadership foundation, Daily Direction Setting, Driving Operational Efficiency; Autonomous Maintenance; planned Maintenance; Focused Improvement; Education and Training; Environmental, Health and Safety; Quality; Organization; Supply Network; Early Equipment Management) with the objective of owning your space, owning your performance (Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Mobilization, Nature) and owning your continuous improvement.  Compensation & Benefits: Danone North America additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. About You The ideal candidate will bring a combination of education, experience, and skills that enable them to excel in this position. The following qualifications outline what we’re looking for, including both required and preferred criteria: Education & Experience: A high school diploma or GED is required. A bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, Food Science, or related field is preferred. In lieu of completed degree, a combination of education and work experience will be considered. 10+ years of production management experience in a high-speed food / beverage/ CPG manufacturing environment, required. 2+ years of UHT dairy processing experience (preferred). Experience in consumer packaging and continuous improvement methodologies (i.e. IWS, Lean, TPM), required. Experience with budget and cost management, required. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities: Ability to establish and react to changing priorities Ability to prioritize plant operations in light of multiple priorities and conflicting demands. Strong knowledge of GMP’s - to include regulations which govern food products Knowledge of safety policies and procedures regarding chemicals, equipment/machinery Excellent negotiation skills. - including an ability to understand sensitive situations. Strong leadership skills, strong influential ability and strong interpersonal and communication skills required to interact successfully with all levels of plant and organization, as well as to develop and coach teams. Strong analytical ability and have demonstrated problem solving and decision-making skills; ability to make decisions with limited information and to handle uncertainty and change. Strong organizational skills, with the ability to schedule activities, and are process-oriented; able to identify process improvements and implement change successfully. You have ability to support a 24/7 production environment as business needs dictate. Work schedules could include day or night shift schedules, and occasional weekends as business needs dictate. About Us Danone U.S. is part of Danone North America, a purpose-driven company and an industry leader in the food and beverage category. You’ll work with some of the best-known food and beverage brands in the world. Our strong portfolio of brands includes: Activia®, DanActive®, Danimals®, Dannon®, evian®, Follow Your Heart®, Happy Family® Organics, International Delight®, Light + Fit®, Nutricia ®, Oikos®, Silk®, So Delicious® Dairy Free, STōK® Cold Brew Coffee ®, Too Good & Co™, and YoCrunch®. With approximately 5,000 employees and 13 production locations across the U.S., Danone North America's mission is to bring health through food to as many people as possible. You’ll be part of one of the largest Certified B Corps™ in the world, working to make sure our company creates real value for people and the planet. Come join our movement for a healthier world: One Planet. One Health BY YOU. Danone North America is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. It is our policy to give equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to legally protected characteristics, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state/provincial and/or local law. For our EEO policy statement and your EEO rights under law click here. #LI-NORAM #LI-ONSITE California Data Privacy Law

Experience in Contract Manufacturing and/or Direct Material sourcing will be a strong asset. Position Responsibilities: Sourcing Strategies & Market Analysis Sourcing strategies development through market studies to identify best practices, identify gaps, risks and opportunities as well as to identify new suppliers and develop a supplier base; Conduct supply market analysis and drivers for spend categories to track market, evaluate cost proposals, and ensure 3PM business is aligned with market; Support growth through identification and implementation of adapted partnership with retained suppliers; Participate in Make or Buy process for new initiatives to support sourcing decisions Execute best practice strategic sourcing practices that support the BUs Strat Plan Work collaboratively with colleagues in terms of pricing, quality and supply chain aspects. Supplier and Contract Management Implement Supplier Relationship Management to improve supplier’s performance, establish best quality, collaboration, innovation and cost Support initiatives to find available innovation/production capacity/capabilities Develop and launch RFQs / RFPs (request for quotation/proposal) to select suppliers in targeted categories Analyze the proposals and make recommendations to key internal stake holders Negotiate quality, time and cost of service as well as other commercial terms and conditions Lead contract ratification activities, assuring interaction with supplier and Legal teams Execution of contract management/admin life cycle of through maximizing financial and operational performance and minimizing risk Project Management Collaborate with R&I & Marketing innovation teams by providing key insight on current capabilities, manufacturing site potential, and economic feasibility. Continuously monitor, review and communicate the project status (with respect to contractual commitments of the supplier). Anticipate and alert key stake holders in case of non-compliance with the contractual commitments.
