jobs.title: CDD 8 mois - Supply Chain Performance & Projects Manager - (H/F)
jobs.description: A PROPOS DE L'OFFRE Danone France ne cherche pas à être la meilleure entreprise au monde, mais meilleure pour le monde ! C'est pour cela que nos 26 marques en France sont certifiées B Corp TM. * B Corp est la boussole de notre stratégie RSE ! Cette certification permet de nous remettre en question afin de progresser continuellement et mesurer notre performance sociale et environnementale. Brive-la-Gaillarde, c’est le site Blédina dédié à la fabrication de nourriture pour bébé. 4 lignes de production sont présentes : les petits pots en verre, les compotes et lactés, les assiettes et les bols aseptiques. Depuis l’été 2024, une cinquième ligne dédiée à la nutrition médicale est venue étoffer le portefeuille de produits. C’est surtout près de 350 salariés sur un site qui délivre environ 30 000 tonnes de nourriture infantile chaque année dont près de 80% pour le marché français. Notre mission ? faire grandir les bébés. Pour cela, nous créons, fabriquons et vendons des produits qui favorisent leur épanouissement. En tant que Supply Chain Performance & Projects Manager, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la performance globale de la chaîne logistique du site. Vos responsabilités incluent : • Définition et suivi des indicateurs de performance Supply Chain sur les flux amont et aval (End-to-End) : OTIF fournisseurs et clients, taux de service client (CFR), coût €/palettes expédiées, pertes matières, facturation… • Pilotage du dashboard Supply Chain, en collaboration étroite avec les équipes approvisionnements, planning, logistique et le service financier pour l’atterrissage budgétaire annuel. • Garantie de la conformité des référentiels (matières premières, emballages, produits finis, clients) et des contrôles réglementaires internes associés. • Élaboration de l’appel d’offres du transport primaire annuel du site. • Mise en œuvre de la feuille de route projet, structurante pour l’activité et le site : o Projet de changement du WMS actuel : implémentation d’un nouvel outil Warehouse Management System (WMS) au 1er trimestre 2027 o Projets LEAN transverses (systèmes, outils, aspects financiers et humains) o Digitalisation, développement des compétences outils et key users, optimisation des processus • Formalisation des modes opératoires pour garantir la pérennité des processus. • Vous pourrez être amené à être Key User sur les systèmes et outils Supply Chain, ainsi que de la formalisation des modes opératoires A PROPOS DE VOUS Nous sommes fiers de promouvoir la diversité et l’égalité des chances au sein de nos équipes. Nous sommes convaincus que nos différences font la différence et qu’un environnement de travail inclusif stimulera notre croissance en tant qu'entreprise, en tant qu'équipes et en tant qu'individus. Nous considérerons donc toutes les candidatures* en favorisant une culture de travail inclusive où chaque individu peut se sentir à sa place. Aussi, nous avons fait le choix de supprimer l’écriture inclusive de nos offres d’emploi car sa complexité pénalise les personnes affectées d’un handicap cognitif, notamment la dyslexie, la dysphasie ou l’apraxie. *Toutes les candidatures seront considérées sans tenir compte de l’origine, du parcours, de la religion, du sexe, de l’orientation sexuelle, de l’identité de genre, du handicap… • Diplômé(e) d’une école de commerce, d’ingénieur ou d’université avec une spécialisation en Supply Chain/Logistique, ou doté(e) d’une expérience significative en industrie agroalimentaire qui vous a permis d’appréhender les fonctions Supply • Capacité à piloter des projets avec efficacité : gestion des priorités, planification, coordination. • Maîtrise de l’anglais courant et des outils informatiques : ERP SAP, Power BI, Excel. • Aptitude à travailler en transversalité avec les fonctions Approvisionnement, Logistique, Achats, Production, Qualité, Finance… • Rigueur, sens analytique et méthodologie, avec une capacité à évoluer dans un environnement changeant et à proposer des solutions pragmatiques à des problématiques complexes. A PROPOS DE NOUS One Planet, One Health - BY YOU ! Nos quatre valeurs fondamentales "HOPE" : HUMANISME, OUVERTURE, PROXIMITÉ et ENTHOUSIASME nous servent de boussole. Chaque jour, vous prendrez des décisions qui ont un impact sur nos performances économiques et sociétales, ainsi que sur notre capacité à atteindre nos ambitions. Chez Danone, vous pourrez simplement être vous-même. Nous sommes convaincus que c’est à VOUS de définir votre façon de travailler, de vous développer et de progresser. Avec nous, vous travaillerez dans un environnement challengeant, authentique et bienveillant. Vous souhaitez en savoir plus sur le quotidien des danoners ? Retrouvez nos actualités sur notre page Linkedin et notre compte @DanoneTalentFrance sur Instagram. Vous souhaitez agir pour apporter la santé par l'alimentation au plus grand nombre ? Rejoignez-nous ! #LI-FR (pour l’externe – à mettre de couleur blanche pour que ça ne se voit pas dans l’annonce)

jobs.title: Human Resources Business Partner
jobs.description: About The Job Danone is one of the biggest FMCG companies and is focusing on bringing health through food to as many people as possible. Do you want to join us to contribute to a healthier world? We are now looking for a: HR Business Partner (Full-time, Location: Romania, Bucharest, Hybrid) The HR Business Partner partners with managers and employees to deliver efficient, consistent and compliant HR support across the entire employee lifecycle. The role focuses on the execution of core HR processes, providing day-to-day HR guidance, supporting people managers, and contributing to a positive employee experience. Working closely with the wider HR team, local and regional, the HR Business Partner ensures operational excellence while continuously improving HR practices and processes. Why should YOU apply right away? If you need more than our great company culture, you should keep in mind the opportunity to: Develop your career in a dynamic and purpose-driven environment Enjoy a flexible hybrid working setup (minimum 2 days/week in-office) Receive a medical subscription extended to your spouse and children Celebrate your birthday with an extra paid day off Explore thousands of courses through LinkedIn Learning, to boost your skills anytime Access Bookster - your gateway to inspiration and self-development through reading Benefit from our Employee Assistance Program for mental well-being and support YOUR responsibilities: Employee Lifecycle & HR Operations * Manage and coordinate HR activities across the full employee lifecycle, including onboarding, probation, internal mobility, promotions, organizational changes and offboarding. * Ensure timely, accurate and compliant execution of all employee lifecycle processes. * Coordinate collaboration with HR Administration (DBS) to ensure smooth execution of operational HR processes. * Provide guidance to managers and employees on HR policies, procedures and people-related matters. * Maintain accurate employee data and documentation within HR systems. * Support the implementation of local and global HR initiatives and process improvements. *Partner with business leaders to support workforce planning and define optimal organizational structures aligned with business needs. *Contribute to organizational design initiatives, including updates to organizational structures, job descriptions, and implementation of organizational changes. Employee Relations * Support managers on employee relations and labor law topics, providing guidance on HR policies, procedures, and people-related matters * Provide first-line support on employee relations matters in line with company policies and local labor legislation. * Assist in resolving routine employee issues and support investigations when required. * Promote a fair, consistent and positive employee experience. Process Improvement * Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, increase efficiency and enhance employee experience. * Collaborate cross-functionally on HR projects and initiatives, continuously seeking innovative ways to improve employee experience and organizational effectiveness. * Support the implementation of local and global HR initiatives. * Contribute to the standardization and continuous improvement of HR practices. HR Reporting & Compliance * Prepare and maintain HR reports and monitor key HR metrics. * Ensure compliance with labor legislation, internal policies and HR governance requirements. * Maintain accurate HR records and documentation (employees files). Business Partnership * Build effective working relationships with managers and employees, acting as a trusted HR partner for day-to-day people matters. * Provide guidance on HR policies, procedures and best practices. * Support managers in addressing employee-related topics and escalating complex cases when appropriate. * Partner with business leaders to ensure consistent application of HR policies and processes. Performance & Talent Processes (for area in responsibility) * Support the execution of annual HR cycles, including performance management, talent reviews and development planning. * Guide managers through performance and development processes. * Monitor completion of key people processes and follow up where needed. Key Competencies * Customer and service orientation * Strong communication and interpersonal skills * Relationship building and stakeholder management * Planning and organizational skills * Attention to detail * Problem-solving and sound judgment * Collaboration and teamwork * Accountability and ownership * Adaptability and learning agility * Continuous improvement mindset About You We are looking for a HR Business Partner with the following profile: * Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field. * 3–5 years of work experience in Human Resources, out of which minim 2 years HR Business Partner applied experience (previous experience in FMCG is an advantage). * Good knowledge of HRBP processes across the employee lifecycle. * Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. * Proactive, agile, and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to adapt in a dynamic business environment * High level of initiative, flexibility, and collaboration. * Good understanding of local labor legislation. * Experience working with HRIS systems is an advantage. * Strong organizational and analytical skills. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. * Fluent in English, both written and spoken. * Experience in the FMCG industry and exposure to diverse business environments would be an advantage Success Measures * Timely and accurate delivery of HR processes across the employee lifecycle. * High-quality support provided to managers and employees. * Strong compliance with HR policies and labor legislation. * Accurate HR data and reporting. * Positive stakeholder feedback. * Active contribution to process improvements and operational excellence. About Us Danone’s mission is bringing health through food to as many people as possible and we want to invite people to join the movement for a healthier world. We recognize the power people should impact the world through their daily choices. Healthy food needs a healthy planet, and this is what our new signature One Planet One Health embodies. We embrace diversity in our organization. This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability status. Are you interested in joining us? Hit the “Apply” button. To comply with GDPR regulations, we cannot process your personal data without given consent. Therefore, we strongly recommend applying directly via our career website.

jobs.description: A PROPOS DE L'OFFRE Vous cherchez un stage ? Nous vous proposons bien plus qu’une candidature. Intéressé par nos opportunités de stages ? Alors ne postulez pas comme tout le monde. jobs.title: Quality & Food Safety Manager Operations
jobs.description: OVER DE FUNCTIE Zorg jij ervoor dat kwaliteit en voedselveiligheid in de fabriek elke dag centraal staan? Voor onze productiesite zijn we op zoek naar een gedreven Quality & Food Safety Manager Operations. In deze rol ben je de drijvende kracht achter de dagelijkse kwaliteits- en voedselveiligheidswerking op de volledige site. Je werkt nauw samen met productie, technische diensten, het labo en de overige leden van de kwaliteitsafdeling om te zorgen voor veilige, conforme en kwalitatieve producten voor onze consumenten. Als Quality & Food Safety Manager Operations: Ben je verantwoordelijk voor het behandelen van productiegerelateerde incidenten, zowel interne afwijkingen als consumentenklachten. Begeleid en leid je root cause analyses en zorg je voor een effectieve opvolging van corrigerende en preventieve acties. Documenteer je onderzoeken in het Veeva systeem Ben je in contact met leveranciers van materialen en grondstoffen in kader van onderzoeken en klachten Neem je beslissingen over vrijgave, blokkering of afkeuring van betrokken producten. Waak je over de implementatie en naleving van Quality & Food Safety standaarden, waaronder HACCP. Draag je actief bij aan een permanente audit- en inspectieklare organisatie. Analyseer je kwaliteits- en voedselveiligheidsdata, zoals klachten, non-conformiteiten, producttrends en kwaliteitsverliezen en gebruik je deze data om samen met relevante afdelingen prioriteiten te bepalen en actieplannen op te stellen. Rapporteer je KPI's en stuurinformatie naar verschillende stakeholders. Ondersteun je de productieafdelingen bij het terugdringen van kwaliteitsgerelateerde verliezen. Identificeer je trainingsnoden op vlak van QFS en coach en train je QFS-coördinatoren en medewerkers op de werkvloer. Werk je actief mee aan de versterking van de kwaliteits- en voedselveiligheidscultuur binnen de organisatie. Neem je een actieve rol op binnen continuous improvement en loss elimination initiatieven. Ben je het aanspreekpunt voor alle operationele Quality & Food Safety vraagstukken. Ben je verantwoordelijk voor het pestcontrole systeem en vormt de link met het externe bedrijf dat dit programma mee begeleidt OVER JOU Wij zoeken een collega die: Een masterdiploma heeft in voedingsmiddelentechnologie, biowetenschappen, industrieel ingenieur of een gelijkaardige richting. Ervaring heeft binnen kwaliteit, voedselveiligheid of productie in een industriële omgeving. Goede kennis heeft van HACCP, kwaliteitsmanagementsystemen en relevante wetgeving. Sterk is in probleemoplossend denken en root cause analyses. Data kan analyseren en vertalen naar concrete verbeteracties. Vlot samenwerkt en communiceert met verschillende afdelingen en stakeholders. Een coachende en enthousiasmerende leiderschapsstijl hanteert. Zich comfortabel voelt in een operationele omgeving waar aanwezigheid op de werkvloer essentieel is. Actiegericht is en een groot gevoel voor verantwoordelijkheid heeft Hands-on en pragmatisch is Een zeer goede kennis Nederlands bezit en een goede kennis Engels OVER ONS Je maakt deel uit van een van de meest toonaangevende en innovatieve voedingsmiddelenbedrijven ter wereld. De fabriek in Rotselaar is daarenboven het grootste Danone zuivelfabriek van Europa en is in 2023 bekroond met de "Factory of the Future" award. We bieden je een uitdagende rol in een ambitieuze organisatie, onderdeel van een groot internationaal concern, met een prettige, informele werksfeer. Mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en het beste uit jezelf te halen! Daarnaast hebben we natuurlijk ook uitstekende primaire en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals bedrijfswagen, bonussysteem, maaltijdcheques, hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering, enz, ... In al onze activiteiten respecteren wij de Danone waarden die fundamenteel zijn in ons bedrijf: Humanisme, Openheid, Betrokkenheid en Enthousiasme. Deze waarden leiden ons in hoe wij werken en met elkaar omgaan. Ben jij een energiek persoon die in deze principes gelooft, dan past Danone bij jou. #LI-BE OVER DE FUNCTIE Are you passionate about quality and food safety, and do you thrive in a fast-paced manufacturing environment? Join our team as Quality & Food Safety Manager Operations and play a key role in ensuring our products consistently meet the highest standards of safety, compliance, and quality. Tasks and responsibilities: Be responsible for handling production-related incidents, including internal non-conformities and consumer complaints. Lead and facilitate root cause analyses and ensure the effective follow-up of corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs). Document investigations in the Veeva system. Liaise with suppliers of packaging materials and raw materials in the context of investigations and complaints. Make decisions regarding the release, quarantine, or rejection of affected products. Ensure the implementation and compliance of Quality & Food Safety standards, including HACCP requirements. Contribute actively to maintaining a permanent audit- and inspection-ready organization. Analyze quality and food safety data, such as complaints, non-conformities, product trends, and quality losses, and use these insights to define priorities and develop action plans together with relevant departments. Report KPIs and management information to various stakeholders. Support production departments in reducing quality-related losses. Identify Quality & Food Safety training needs and coach and train QFS coordinators and shop floor employees. Actively contribute to strengthening the quality and food safety culture across the organization. Play an active role in continuous improvement and loss elimination initiatives. Serve as the key point of contact for all operational Quality & Food Safety matters. Be responsible for the pest control system and act as the liaison with the external service provider supporting this program. OVER JOU We are looking for a colleague who: Holds a Master's degree in Food Technology, Bioscience Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. Has experience in Quality, Food Safety, or Production within an industrial/manufacturing environment. Has a solid knowledge of HACCP, Quality Management Systems, and relevant food safety regulations. Demonstrates strong problem-solving skills and expertise in root cause analysis. Is able to analyze data and translate insights into concrete improvement actions. Works effectively and communicates confidently with various departments and stakeholders. Adopts a coaching and inspiring leadership style. Feels comfortable in an operational environment where a strong presence on the shop floor is essential. Is action-oriented and has a strong sense of ownership and accountability. Has a hands-on and pragmatic mindset. Has a very good knowledge of Dutch and a good knowledge of English OVER ONS You are part of one of the most leading and innovative food companies in the world. Moreover, the factory in Rotselaar is the largest Danone dairy factory in Europe and was awarded the ‘Factory of the Future’ award in 2023. We offer you a challenging role in an ambitious organization, part of a large international group, with a pleasant and informal working atmosphere. Opportunities to further develop yourself and bring out the best in you! Additionally, we provide excellent primary and secondary employment conditions, including a company car, bonus system, meal vouchers, health insurance, and more. In all our activities, we uphold the fundamental Danone values: Humanism, Openness, Commitment, and Enthusiasm. These values guide us in how we work and interact with each other. If you're an energetic person who believes in these principles, you are the right person to join our team! #LI-BE

jobs.title: Stagiaire Learning & Development
jobs.description: OVER DE FUNCTIE Nutricia Cuijk B.V. is een gespecialiseerd onderdeel van Danone Specialized Nutrition en behoort wereldwijd tot de grootste producenten van babyvoeding. Met focus op wetenschappelijk ontwikkelde voeding levert Nutricia bewezen voordelen voor consumenten en betere klinische uitkomsten voor baby's. Hiermee ondersteunt Nutricia Danone's bredere missie om via voeding een bijdrage te leveren aan de gezondheid van zoveel mogelijk mensen, overal ter wereld. Wil jij ondersteuning bieden aan deze missie door middel van training en opleiding? Voor onze afdeling Learning & Development zoeken wij een: Stagiaire Learning & Development De afdeling Learning & Development (L&D) is onderdeel van het HR team en bestaat uit een L&D manager, een L&D advisor en een L&D coördinator. De afdeling houdt zich bezig met het ontwikkelen van gedrag, kennis en kunde binnen de organisatie. Dit doet de afdeling onder andere door trainingsprogramma’s te faciliteren en organiseren voor de werknemers van Nutricia Cuijk. Alle resultaten worden vastgelegd in het Leer Management Systeem (LMS). Er liggen veel uitdagingen voor de afdeling L&D vanwege de uitbreidingen van de fabriek. Durf jij het aan om hierin een significante bijdrage te leveren? Er zijn meerdere mogelijkheden om een stageopdracht of afstudeeropdracht vorm te geven, wij zijn ook benieuwd naar jouw interesse en motivatie. Daarnaast ben je onderdeel van het L&D team, hierbinnen ondersteun je in administratieve en organisatorische zaken zoals: Het plannen en organiseren van trainingen Certificaat & registratiemanagement Evalueren & verbeteren van trainingsprogramma’s Faciliteren / ondersteunen bij trainingen zoals onze Welkom bij Nutricia introductiedag Ondersteunen bij het beheer van onze opleidingsinbox Wil jij afstuderen of stagelopen bij de afdeling L&D van Danone Nutricia en herken je jezelf in onderstaand profiel? Reageer dan snel! OVER JOU Over jou Je gaat afstuderen (of studeert) als student A&O Psychologie, Onderwijskunde, Human Resources of Bedrijfskunde. Je bent zelf startend, communicatief vaardig en energiek Uiteraard ben je vaardig in Excel & Microsoft Office Je vindt het leuk om als eerste aanspreekpunt voor L&D te functioneren omtrent allerlei zaken rondom ontwikkeling en training van medewerkers. Je bent hands on en houdt ervan om de mouwen op te stropen Verder heb je een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift. Je bent beschikbaar rond januari/februari 2027 voor 5 a 6 maanden, 4 tot 5 dagen per week Je bent bereid te reizen naar onze fabriek in Haps Daarnaast is het belangrijk dat je je goed kunt inleven in & samenwerken met anderen op verschillende niveaus, je ondersteunt collega’s waar nodig en begrijpt de belangrijkheid / impact van Learning & Development op onze bedrijfsprocessen. OVER ONS Over ons De fabriek Nutricia Haps is onderdeel van Danone en staat voor innovatie, geavanceerde technologie en kwaliteit door de zeer hoge Safety & Quality-normen die wij stellen aan de kwetsbare groepen: zuigelingen, ouderen en zieken. De missie van Nutricia is om het Centre of Excellence te zijn in de productie van ultrafiltratie- en hydrolyseproducten voor Danone wereldwijd. De ambitie van Nutricia Haps is om via Operational Excellence babyvoeding van de beste kwaliteit te voorzien, in de juiste hoeveelheden en op tijd. Voor mensen met een hoge dosis energie en inzet, is Nutricia Cuijk de perfecte plek om een succesvolle carrière op te bouwen. Ми не дискримінуємо за ознакою раси, кольору шкіри, політичних чи релігійних переконань, статі, віку, інвалідності, етнічного та соціального походження, громадянства, сексуальної орієнтації, сімейного та майнового стану, статусу ветерана, чи за будь-якою іншою ознакою.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description: About the Job Job Summary At Danone, Manufacturing the best products and supplying them to meet demand is a key driver for our plant teams. We are currently looking to hire a Financial Analyst based in our Mt Crawford, Virginia beverage manufacturing plant. This role will have a focus on raw material accounting, loss & labor analysis, inventory control, fixed asset accounting, spare parts, controllable cost control, utility tracking, and internal controls in a continuous improvement environment. Reporting into the Plant Controller, this role supports the Controller in the month end close process with clear & concise variance analysis, weekly forecast & annual strategic plan. Key Responsibilities As a key member of our team, you will play an important role in driving our mission forward. The following responsibilities outline the core expectations and contributions for this position: Input/learn/report weekly key performance indicators and ensure their accuracy, understand and communicate impact of these measures to the business. Track operations productivity projects, execution, and financial impact. Quickly analyze data, identify variances, and benchmark information against other locations. Perform plant cost accounting functions with emphasis on month end close, material loss and labor variance analysis, spare parts, fixed assets, and report preparation for use by Corporate HQ and local plant management Assists Plant Controller in the preparation, review and analysis of plant level budgets and forecasts. Ability to find gaps in financial controls & analysis and develop effective processes, which close the respective shortfalls. Review and approve monthly reconciliations for submission to corporate consolidation. Ability to multitask and effectively prioritize in a Continuous Improvement manufacturing environment. Proficiency in extracting data from SAP downloading in Excel for a clear analytical review Create SOPs and conduct reviews & request changes as necessary Aid Operations to identify, document, and implement solutions for issues within the production process Effectively communicate with several plant departments (e.g., packaging, processing, maintenance, etc.) Assist in the purchase order process for locally procured goods & services Manage and assist with special projects Be a key contributor in the annual strategic business plan & rolling forecast for expenses based on forecasted volume Perform all other assigned tasks/duties Physical Demands This role could require standing for extended periods and lifting up to 25 lbs. Work Environment Work is performed in a manufacturing environment with exposure to moderate noise and temperature variations. Work schedules could include nights, weekends and/or holidays to provide the ability to support a 24/7 manufacturing environment as business needs dictate. Engagement in our Integrated Work Systems Ensure adherence to plant standards and procedures (including but not limited to GMP, AIB, FDA, IWS, Quality, Safety, Finance, ISO, HOPE, Danone Behaviors, Daily Direction Setting, Driving OE). As a fundamental piece of the organization, your responsibility is to participate and own the implementation and deployment of IWS system and its pillars (Leadership foundation, Daily Direction Setting, Driving OE; Autonomous Maintenance; planned Maintenance; Focused Improvement; Education and Training; Environmental, Health and Safety; Quality; Organization; Supply Network; Early Equipment Management) with the objective of owning your space, owning your performance (Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Mobilization, Nature) and owning your continuous improvement. Compensation & Benefits: The salary range for this position is: $87K - $124K. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone USA additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. About You The ideal candidate will bring a combination of education, experience, and skills that enable them to excel in this position. The following qualifications outline what we’re looking for, including both required and preferred criteria: Education & Experience: A bachelor’s degree in accounting/finance or related field is required. Minimum 2 years of cost accounting experience in a manufacturing environment, preferred. Candidates without a completed bachelor’s degree in finance/accounting or related field, will be considered if they have 5-7 years in a manufacturing environment within a materials, planning, or supply chain type of role and have demonstrated ability to understand and interpret financial budgets and analysis as well as exceptional excel skills. Candidates must also have completed high school diploma/GED. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities: Must have strong computer skills including proficiency in MS Office products (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), required. required ERP Systems experience (SAP preferred), Must have solid interpersonal, analytical and technical skills required. Ability to communicate complex accounting information verbally and in writing, required. Strong attention to detail, possess the ability to multi-task, prioritize, adapt and be flexible, required. Must demonstrate resiliency, determination and proactively anticipate business needs, required. Must have the ability to support a 24/7 manufacturing environment, as business needs dictate. About Us Danone U.S. is part of Danone North America, a purpose-driven company and an industry leader in the food and beverage category. You’ll work with some of the best-known food and beverage brands in the world. Our strong portfolio of brands includes: Activia®, DanActive®, Danimals®, Dannon®, evian®, Follow Your Heart®, Happy Family® Organics, International Delight®, Light + Fit®, Nutricia ®, Oikos®, Silk®, So Delicious® Dairy Free, STōK® Cold Brew Coffee ®, Too Good & Co™, and YoCrunch®. With approximately 5,000 employees and 13 production locations across the U.S., Danone North America's mission is to bring health through food to as many people as possible. jobs.title: Financial Analyst - Dallas, TX
jobs.description: About the Job At Danone, manufacturing the best products and supplying them to meet demand is a key driver for our plant teams. We are currently looking to hire a Finance Analyst based in our Dallas, Texas beverage manufacturing plant. This position is ideal for a candidate with a strong accounting and cost accounting background who is passionate about financial analysis and business partnering within a manufacturing environment. The role will have primary responsibility for supporting plant accounting activities including journal entries, accruals, account reconciliations, inventory accounting, payroll analysis, fixed assets, cost center management, month-end close, and financial statement analysis. The successful candidate will partner closely with Operations, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and Corporate Finance to provide meaningful financial insights, improve financial controls, and support business decisions. This role will also support the Plant Controller in the month-end close process, weekly forecasting, annual operating plan development, and strategic financial planning through clear and concise variance analysis and reporting. Responsibilities include: Prepare and post monthly journal entries while ensuring compliance with company accounting policies and internal controls. Maintain a strong understanding of general ledger accounting concepts, including debits, credits, accruals, prepaids, and account reconciliations. Perform monthly Balance Sheet reconciliations and support Income Statement reviews and variance analysis. Analyze and monitor plant cost centers, identifying risks and opportunities to meet financial targets. Support payroll accounting processes and labor cost analysis. Develop and present financial analyses, forecasts, and business cases to plant leadership and cross-functional teams. Create and manage purchase orders through Coupa and support procurement-related financial processes. Develop Power BI dashboards and reporting tools to improve visibility of key operational and financial KPIs. Support inventory accuracy initiatives and conduct periodic analysis of material consumption, losses, and manufacturing variances. Drive continuous improvement initiatives through data analysis and process standardization. The salary range for this position is $73k-99k USD. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone USA additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. (**For worker level roles: Review for applicability for each site**). About You Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required. CPA, CMA, or progress toward certification is a plus. Minimum of 3 years of accounting, cost accounting, or financial analysis experience in a manufacturing environment required. Strong understanding of general ledger accounting, journal entries, debits and credits, accruals, payroll accounting, account reconciliations, and month-end close processes. Demonstrated experience analyzing Income Statements, Balance Sheets, cost centers, manufacturing variances, labor costs, and operational performance metrics. Experience with inventory accounting, fixed assets, standard costing, and manufacturing financial reporting. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, INDEX/MATCH, advanced formulas, Power Query, and data analysis techniques. Experience with Power BI dashboard development and data visualization preferred. ERP experience required; SAP and Coupa experience strongly preferred. Strong financial modeling, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends and provide actionable recommendations. Excellent presentation and communication skills with the ability to explain financial concepts to both finance and non-finance audiences. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. Proven ability to build relationships and partner effectively with Operations, Supply Chain, Maintenance, Engineering, and Plant Leadership teams. Ability to support a 24/7 manufacturing environment as business needs dictate. About Us Danone USA is an industry-leading food & beverage company, with a mission to bring health through food to as many people as possible. Founded in the Bronx in 1942 as Dannon Milk Products, Danone USA now employs 5,000 people across more than 10 U.S. manufacturing facilities. (Excluyente). -Conocimientos en: Excel, avanzado (excluyente). -Idioma: Inglés, intermedio (excluyente). ¿Qué podrá diferenciarte? -Proactividad. -Autonomía. -Flexibilidad y capacidad de adaptación. -Perfil analítico y orientación a la resolución de problemas. -Capacidad para relacionarse con diferentes áreas del negocio. SOBRE NOSOTROS #li-hybrid Nuestros beneficios: • Danone es bienestar: apoyamos la salud física y mental de nuestros Danoners con prepaga, asistencia médica y nutricional, apoyo de almuerzo, Gympass y productos saludables Danone. • Danone es desarrollo personal: promovemos formación "on the job", con oportunidades de entrenamiento, mentoreo y desarrollo de las habilidades del futuro. • Danone es acompaña a las familias: con licencias extendidas para cuidadores primarios y secundarios, lactario en oficinas y apoyo en gastos de guardería, alimentos y kits escolares. • Danone es trabajar con propósito: perseguimos un doble propósito empresarial de promover el éxito del negocio siempre de la mano del progreso social. jobs.title: Financial Analyst - Finance Operations - Danone Canada
jobs.description: About The Job As part of this mandate, you will assume the following responsibilities: Your mission is to act as a Finance Operations partner, contributing to month‑end closing and Group reporting while supporting productivity, savings, and CAPEX initiatives across Operations. You will also play a key role in data integrity, and continuous improvement of finance templates and processes, while supporting the Finance Operations Senior Manager in forecasts, estimates, and projections. More specifically: Support the Project Management Team in estimating and reporting of Productivity initiatives. Take end-to-end ownership of Iproview (savings reporting tool) and Orsoft (master data tool) as Ops finance representative. Contribute to the month‑end closing process, including accrual bookings, variance analysis, and consolidation of operational results to support Americas organiztion. Support forecasting cycles, preparation of cost bridges and COGS/kg analysis. Provide financial support for CAPEX management. Maintain, enhance, and develop reporting and analytical tools used for Finance Operations decision‑making. The annual base salary range for this position is $60,000.00 to $85,000.00 CAD. The final salary offered will be determined by factors such as relevant experience and qualifications, internal equity and external market conditions. Danone Canada also offers a competitive short-term incentive bonus and a comprehensive benefits package, including group insurance, group retirement plans, wellbeing account, flexible time off, true hybrid work environment, paid parental leave, and other attractive options. As part of our commitment to transparency in our hiring practices, we may use AI-enabled tools at certain stages of the recruitment process. However, all final hiring decisions are made by people. This posting is for a new vacancy. About You Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or a related field or equivalent experience; Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience, including financial analysis; CPA designation (or progress toward completion) is considered an asset; Working knowledge of SAP and Power BI is an asset; Advanced proficiency in Excel, including Pivot Tables, Power Pivot, and complex formulas, with the ability to analyze and manipulate large datasets from multiple information systems; Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and data accuracy; Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment with tight deadlines; High level of autonomy, rigor, organization, and methodological approach; Bilingual (English and French) is an asset; Strong communication and stakeholder‑management skills. Curiosity, willingness to learn, and motivation to take on new challenges. About Us Danone Canada is part of Danone, the largest certified B Corp™ in the world, proudly using our business as a force for good – creating value for people, communities, and the planet. Guided by our long-standing mission to bring health through food to as many people as possible, we embed this purpose into every aspect of our operations. Our workforce spans the country, with two headquarters (Boucherville, QC, and Toronto, ON), a production facility in Boucherville, and various remote work sites across the provinces. When you join us, you’ll work with some of the best-known food and beverage brands in the world, including Oikos, Activia, Two Good, evian, Silk, International Delight, So Delicious Dairy Free and STōK Cold Brew Coffee. We celebrate unique perspectives and are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. We encourage applications from everyone and offer accommodations upon request to ensure equitable access for all candidates. Join us and help shape a healthier, more sustainable world. One Planet. One Health. Identify and prioritize high-impact processes for digitalization across pilot plant and laboratory operations. Design, implement and continuously improve the end-to-end data workflow, from test request and planning to execution, data capture, reporting, and knowledge capitalization. Act as data steward, ensuring robust data models, metadata standards, governance, quality rules, traceability, reusability, and reliable inputs for KPI calculations and dashboards. Manage daily digital operations, including shopfloor data acquisition, sensor upgrades, laboratory instrument connectivity, workflow updates, software maintenance, troubleshooting, and user support. Identify digital use cases such as real-time monitoring, in-silico models, and virtual pilot approaches to improve trial efficiency, lab performance, knowledge reuse, scale-up confidence, and decision-making. Drive adoption by engaging users, training stakeholders, collecting shopfloor feedback, and adapting solutions to operational needs. Meet your future manager! You will report to Federico Hernandez, Capability & Prototyping Sr Team Leader. About You You bring: Master's degree in Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Automation, Information Systems, or a related scientific discipline. 5-8 years of experience in digital transformation, data systems, automation, or smart manufacturing within an R&D, laboratory, pilot plant, or industrial environment. Strong understanding of pilot plant/lab operations and end-to-end workflows, from planning and execution through data capture and reporting. Hands-on exposure to technologies such as SCADA, MES, Historian, PLC/IIoT, sensors, Azure, Databricks, or equivalent platforms. Experience with LIMS/ELN, scientific data systems, digital twins, simulation, or advanced analytics is a plus. Strong stakeholder management, communication, and change management skills, with the ability to drive user adoption in operational environments. Fluent in English and French, with the ability to work effectively in a French-speaking pilot plant and laboratory environment. Willingness to travel frequently (approximately 60%), primarily to Evian, France. Experience with Azure, Databricks, or other enterprise data platforms is a plus. Familiarity with digital twins, process simulation, modelling, or advanced analytics is a plus. Knowledge of cybersecurity, IT/OT environments, and industrial system lifecycle management is a plus. About Us At Danone we are committed to our mission “bringing health, through food to as many people as possible”. We are working together to make sure that our brands, like Nutricia and Nutrilon, create real benefits for people, communities and the planet. jobs.title: ANZ Lead Category Manager - Raw Materials & Packaging
jobs.description: About The Job Build resilience. Shape strategy. Lead with impact. Join our ANZ Procurement team as ANZ Lead Category Manager - Raw Materials & Packaging and help keep our manufacturing network moving through resilient sourcing, strong supplier partnerships and smart commercial decisions. Based in Sydney or Melbourne, within our Cycles and Procurement function, you will lead the sourcing and procurement of raw materials and packaging across our ANZ plants, translating global strategies into strong local execution. This is a high-impact leadership role with real ownership. You will lead and develop a team of buyers, strengthen security of supply, guide innovation and productivity projects, and build trusted partnerships across our business and supplier network. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to: Lead local sourcing strategies for ingredients and packaging, aligned with global and regional direction. Safeguard continuity of supply through secure sourcing, dual sourcing and effective risk mitigation. Negotiate contracts and pricing for dairy ingredients and liquid milk, driving value and policy compliance. Manage supplier performance, relationships, quality actions and contractual obligations. Lead the sourcing workstream for innovation, renovation, productivity and third-party manufacturing projects. Provide market intelligence and price forecasts to support rolling forecasts and annual planning. Lead and develop three direct reports, setting clear priorities and enabling strong category and supplier management. About You You are a commercially astute procurement professional who combines strategic thinking with practical execution. A confident negotiator and trusted relationship builder, you stay calm under pressure, make fact-based decisions and turn complexity into clear action. Collaborative, accountable and people-focused, you enjoy leading others, navigating competing priorities and creating sourcing solutions that strengthen supply, value and performance. Strong negotiation, relationship management and communication skills. Solid project management, planning and organisational capability. Willingness to travel occasionally to New Zealand and other part of Australia. jobs.title: Brand Manager Consumer Healthcare (Temporal)
jobs.description: SOBRE EL TRABAJO En Danone creemos que la alimentación tiene el poder de mejorar vidas. Nuestra misión es llevar la salud a través de la alimentación al mayor número posible de personas y, desde Specialized Nutrition (Nutricia), trabajamos cada día para hacer realidad este propósito a través de soluciones nutricionales basadas en la ciencia. Buscamos un/a Brand Manager Consumer Healthcare para incorporarse temporalmente al equipo de Marketing de Consumer Healthcare, cubriendo una baja por maternidad. Esta es una oportunidad única para liderar marcas con un fuerte propósito y un impacto directo en la calidad de vida de las personas, en una categoría en plena transformación y crecimiento. Tu misión Serás responsable de desarrollar e impulsar la estrategia y activación de marcas clave como Souvenaid y Fortimel, contribuyendo al crecimiento del negocio y ayudando a construir nuevas oportunidades dentro del ámbito de la nutrición especializada orientada al consumidor. Trabajarás en un entorno altamente transversal, colaborando estrechamente con equipos de Ventas, Medical Affairs, Digital, Finanzas y agencias externas para garantizar una ejecución excelente y el cumplimiento de los objetivos de negocio. ¿Qué harás? Estrategia y ejecución de Plan anual de marca Traducir la estrategia de crecimiento de las marcas en planes de activación claros, accionables y alineados con los diferentes canales y stakeholders clave (consumidor, profesionales sanitarios, farmacia y DTC). Garantizar una ejecución coherente de la marca en todos los puntos de contacto con el consumidor y los profesionales sanitarios. Monitorizar y analizar el performance de negocio, marca y activación, identificando oportunidades de optimización, maximizando el rendimiento y el ROI. Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento y compartir mejores prácticas con equipos internacionales. Brand Planning Apoyar y coordinar el proceso anual de planificación de marca. Definir prioridades, palancas de crecimiento, KPIs y presupuesto. Desarrollo de campañas creativas y toolkits incl. materiales Diseñar y coordinar campañas de comunicación con la agencia creativa dirigidas al consumidor. Desarrollar materiales promocionales y educativos para profesionales sanitarios. Colaborar con el equipo médico y regulatorio para asegurar la solidez científica y el cumplimiento de todos los contenidos. Innovación y lanzamiento de productos Gestionar proyectos de innovación, desde business case y la validación de la propuesta de valor hasta el desarrollo de artworks, la coordinación con equipos multifuncionales y el lanzamiento al mercado. Liderar la definición de propuestas de valor, claims, identidad visual y planes de lanzamiento. SOBRE TI ¿Qué buscamos? Experiencia a partir de 5 años en Marketing de gran consumo, Consumer Healthcare, Nutrición, Farma o categorías afines. Perfil estratégico con capacidad para transformar insights en planes de acción. Conocimiento del consumidor y experiencia trabajando en entornos omnicanal. Mentalidad digital-first y experiencia en campañas digitales, e-commerce o modelos DTC. Capacidad para trabajar en entornos multifuncionales e influir a diferentes stakeholders. Orientación a resultados y experiencia gestionando presupuestos y KPIs. Excelentes capacidades de organización, comunicación y gestión de proyectos. Nivel alto de inglés. SOBRE NOSOTROS ¿Qué ofrecemos? Incorporación a una compañía líder internacional con propósito y fuerte impacto social. Oportunidad de trabajar con marcas innovadoras respaldadas por la ciencia y la nutrición especializada. Exposición a proyectos estratégicos con alto nivel de visibilidad. Entorno dinámico, colaborativo y orientado al aprendizaje continuo. Contrato temporal para cobertura de baja por maternidad. Si te apasiona construir marcas con propósito, trabajar en la intersección entre salud y consumidor, y contribuir a mejorar la vida de las personas a través de la nutrición, nos encantaría conocerte.

jobs.title: Internship (Marketing): Brand Management Alpro
jobs.description: About The Job Are you excited about building strong brands, creating meaningful consumer connections and bringing ideas to life through impactful campaigns? Do you want to gain hands-on experience in brand management within a fast-moving, purpose-driven multinational? Then apply now and join us as a Brand Management Intern at Alpro, starting on 1 February 2027. About the Job At Alpro, we are the pioneers of plant-based. For 40 years, we have been opening minds (and mouths) to the wonders of plant-based eating with our delicious and nutritious drinks, yoghurts, creams and margarines. As a Brand Management Intern, you will join the Benelux Brand Management team, a close-knit team of around 7-8 colleagues based across the Netherlands and Belgium. The team is responsible for defining and executing Alpro's brand and portfolio strategy across the Benelux market. You will work closely with internal departments, creative agencies and external partners while gaining exposure to a wide variety of marketing and brand management activities. This is a dynamic internship where no two days are the same. You will have the opportunity to take ownership of projects, develop new skills and contribute directly to the growth of one of the world's leading plant-based brands. Your main responsibilities include: Supporting the execution of brand campaigns and product launches. Coordinating with creative and media agencies to ensure timely delivery of assets. Supporting website optimisation and digital campaign management. Tracking, analysing and interpreting media and campaign KPIs. Supporting partnerships, influencer activations, festivals and brand events. Coordinating samples, promotional materials and campaign assets. Managing stakeholders across different functions and markets. Supporting internal initiatives and team projects. Taking ownership of independent projects and bringing fresh ideas to the team. About You You are a Bachelor's or Master's student in Marketing, Business Administration or a related field and have already gained some practical experience in marketing or digital marketing. You are enthusiastic about brands, consumer behaviour and creating impactful campaigns. You combine creativity with a data-driven mindset and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders and priorities. We are looking for someone who: Is proactive, organised and comfortable taking ownership. Is resilient and able to switch quickly between priorities. Communicates confidently with both internal and external stakeholders. Is curious, eager to learn and not afraid to ask questions. Has strong project management and organisational skills. Has an interest in both creative marketing and campaign performance data. Is tech-savvy and enjoys working with digital tools and platforms. Preferred Skills Experience with or interest in the following is considered a plus: Power BI NielsenIQ Circana Digital Marketing Campaign Management Data Analysis and Reporting Compulsory Requirements You are enrolled as a Bachelor's or Master's student during the entire internship period. You are available to start on 1 February 2027 for a minimum of 6 months, 5 days per week. You are fluent in English, both spoken and written. Dutch language skills are strongly preferred. You are able to work from our Rijswijk office at least twice per week. You are a resident of the Netherlands and hold a valid BSN number, or are willing and able to obtain one before the start of the internship. If you are a non-EU citizen, you must hold a valid Dutch residence permit and provide a three-party internship agreement signed by your university. jobs.title: Global IT Procurement Director
jobs.description: About The Job As a global leader in health-focused food and beverages, Danone is dedicated to enhancing lives through positive nutrition and hydration. With a presence in over 120 countries, our diverse and innovative portfolio includes dairy and plant-based products, packaged waters, and specialized nutrition. At the core of our company are our HOPE values: Humanism, Openness, Proximity, and Enthusiasm, which guide us in everything we do. Our mission is to bring health through food to as many people as possible, making a positive impact on individuals and communities worldwide. Our Cycles & Procurement (C&P) organisation is instrumental in Danone's success not only as a pivotal partner in meeting our sustainability and nature commitments, but also harnessing the expertise of our external partners who work with us in creating an ecosystem of success for all. Across areas such as innovation, product superiority but also minimising our impact. The C&P organisation is organised by zones (3) and category management, including Indirects and Excellence. Reporting to the Global Head of Indirects, you will own the global IT procurement strategy. Manage a team of 5 including 2 direct reports, and partner closely with Technology, Finance, Legal, Security and senior business stakeholders. Responsibilities Your mission is to move IT procurement beyond sourcing execution through becoming a trusted strategic adviser in technology decisions. You will strengthen Danone’s supplier ecosystem, and enable better choices on cost, innovation, resilience, security, AI-enabled transformation and long-term architecture. In addition but not exclusively you will: • Define and deliver multi-year global category strategies across software, SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, telecoms, cybersecurity, data, AI, SAP and enterprise platforms, IT services and system integrators. • Use market intelligence, supplier roadmaps, benchmarks and technology trends to shape sourcing priorities, including how AI will reshape technology sourcing, supplier models and procurement value creation. • Translate Danone’s digital, data and technology priorities into sourcing roadmaps that balance cost, value, innovation, resilience, security and flexibility. • Engage the business early in major technology decisions, transformation programmes and supplier selections • Build trusted relationships with CIO, CFO and senior functional leaders by speaking the language of technology, finance and the business. • Own the IT procurement value agenda, including productivity, demand management, cash, cost avoidance, supplier innovation, service performance and risk reduction. • Lead complex global negotiations and develop commercial models that reward outcomes, adoption, productivity and innovation, not just capacity or effort. • Develop strong business cases, align stakeholders and secure measurable commitments on value delivery, governance and implementation. • Build and govern a strategic global supplier ecosystem, with executive-level relationships, clear performance expectations and active innovation pipelines. • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing global team, building capability, role clarity, decision rights and accountability for business outcomes. • Strengthen contract and supplier risk management across service levels, cybersecurity, data privacy, AI, intellectual property, benchmarking, audit, termination, liability and business continuity. About You Skills • A strategic technology procurement leader who shapes decisions upstream • Commercially sharp and market-facing, with strong understanding of technology suppliers, pricing models, benchmarks, AI disruption and negotiation levers. • Credible with senior stakeholders, able to influence CIO, CFO and executive-level supplier conversations with confidence and clarity. • Curious, challenging and fact-based, with the confidence to question incumbent choices and create better alternatives. • Comfortable working in ambiguity, across cultures and geographies, and in complex global transformation environments. • A people leader who develops talent, creates focus and builds a culture of performance, collaboration and continuous improvement. Experience • 15+ years in IT procurement, technology sourcing, commercial management or a senior technology-industry role, with experience managing large, complex and global portfolios. • Deep knowledge of the global technology market: software, SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, enterprise platforms, IT services, system integrators, telecoms, cybersecurity, data, AI and emerging technologies. • Strong command of technology commercial models, including enterprise agreements, subscription pricing, licensing, cloud economics, managed services, outsourcing, marketplaces and outcome-based models. • A track record of high-value global negotiations, strategic supplier management and influencing CIO, CFO and senior business stakeholders. • Strong financial, analytical and risk skills, including TCO, benchmarking, supplier dependency, cybersecurity, data privacy, IP and business continuity. • Experience with SAP or major ERP transformations is strongly valued. • Relevant backgrounds include FMCG, finance or banking, technology vendors such as cloud, software or telecom providers, system integrators, managed-services providers and technology consultancies. • Proven ability to build high-performing teams and develop talent. • Fluent English is a must; French is an asset. About Us Working here you’ll need to enjoy a fast-pace and complexity. But it’s packed with opportunities. You’ll work with some of the best-known brands in the world. Be innovative and entrepreneurial and the impact you could make might just amaze you. We are proud to be an equal employer. We are convinced our differences make the difference and that an inclusive working environment will drive our growth as a business, as teams and as individuals. We will therefore consider all applicants for employment* fostering an inclusive working culture that is accessible for all.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst - Fort Worth, TX
jobs.description: About the Job At Danone, manufacturing the best products and supplying them to meet demand is a key driver for our plant teams. We are currently looking to hire a Finance Analyst based in our Fort Worth, Texas manufacturing plant. This role will have a focus on raw material accounting, loss & labor analysis, inventory control, fixed asset accounting, spare parts, controllable cost control, utility tracking, and internal controls in a continuous improvement environment. In this role you will support the Plant Controller in the month end close process with clear & concise variance analysis, weekly forecast & annual strategic plan. In this role, you will be responsible for: Input/learn/report weekly key performance indicators and ensure their accuracy, understand and communicate impact of these measures to the business. Track operations productivity projects, execution, and financial impact. Quickly analyze data, identify variances, and benchmark information against other locations. Perform plant cost accounting functions with emphasis on month end close, material loss and labor variance analysis, spare parts, fixed assets, and report preparation for use by Corporate HQ and local plant management Assists Plant Controller in the preparation, review and analysis of plant level budgets and forecasts. Ability to find gaps in financial controls & analysis and develop effective processes, which close the respective shortfalls. Review and approve monthly reconciliations for submission to corporate consolidation. Ability to multitask and effectively prioritize in a Continuous Improvement manufacturing environment. Proficiency in extracting data from SAP downloading in Excel for a clear analytical review Create SOPs and conduct reviews & request changes as necessary Aid Operations to identify, document, and implement solutions for issues within the production process Effectively communicate with several plant departments (e.g., packaging, processing, maintenance, etc.) Assist in the purchase order process for locally procured goods & services Manage and assist with special projects Be a key contributor in the annual strategic business plan & rolling forecast for expenses based on forecasted volume Manage all aspects of inventory control as it relates to financial impact to the site (cycle count reports, expired materials, obsolete, etc.) Assist in weekly production order variance analysis, working with our onsite WMS team Perform all other assigned tasks/duties The salary range for this position is $73k-99k USD. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone North America additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. About You You have a Bachelor's degree in accounting/finance or related field, required. Candidates without a completed bachelor’s degree in finance/accounting or related field, will be considered if they have 5-7 years in a manufacturing environment within a materials, planning, or supply chain type of role and have demonstrated ability to understand and interpret financial budgets and analysis as well as exceptional excel skills. You have a minimum 2 years of cost accounting experience in a manufacturing environment, preferred. You have strong Computer skills including proficiency in MS Office products (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), required. ERP Systems experience (SAP preferred), required. You have solid interpersonal, analytical and technical skills, required. You have the ability to communicate complex accounting information verbally and in writing, required. You have strong attention to detail, possess the ability to multi-task, prioritize, adapt and be flexible, required. You are resilient, determined and proactively anticipates business needs, required. You are able to support a 24/7 manufacturing environment, as business needs dictate. About Us Danone USA is an industry-leading food & beverage company, with a mission to bring health through food to as many people as possible. Founded in the Bronx in 1942 as Dannon Milk Products, Danone USA now employs 5,000 people across more than 10 U.S. manufacturing facilities. When you join Danone USA, you’ll help make products for well-known brands including Activia®, DanActive®, Danimals®, Dannon®, evian®, Follow Your Heart®, Happy Family® Organics, International Delight®, Light + Fit®, Nutricia ®, Oikos®, Silk®, So Delicious® Dairy Free, STōK® Cold Brew Coffee ®, Too Good & Co™, and YoCrunch®. You’ll be part of one of the largest Certified B Corps™ in the world, working to make sure our company creates real value for people and the planet. Danone USA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. It is our policy to give equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to legally protected characteristics, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state/provincial and/or local law. For our EEO policy statement and your EEO rights under law click here. #LI-NORAM #LI-ONSITE #LI-BL1 Employee & Applicant Privacy Policy

jobs.title: HR Manager Finland
jobs.description: About The Job Ready for your next step in HR, with the opportunity to combine local ownership with international exposure? At Danone, we believe that people are at the heart of building a healthier and more sustainable future. We are now looking for an experienced and curious HR professional to join our North Europe HR team! This is a varied role combining two important dimensions: acting as the locally responsible HR contact for Finland and driving HR initiatives across the region, with the opportunity to contribute to and influence projects at North Europe level. It is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys being close to employees and managers while also working with data, digital tools and cross-market HR projects. This is a permanent, full-time position based at our Helsinki office, with a start date as soon as possible. You will be expected to work on-site for the majority of the working week. About the role As HR Manager, you will be the main HR point of contact for employees and managers in Finland, independently supporting the local organisation, driving local engagement and providing guidance based on Finnish employment law, regulations and market practices. Alongside your responsibility in Finland, you will lead and contribute to broader HR initiatives and projects, collaborating with stakeholders across the organisation and bringing your market perspective into wider ways of working. The projects and areas you take ownership of may evolve over time and will be shaped together with your manager, based on business priorities and your strengths. Your main responsibilities will include, but are not limited to: Act as the main HR contact for employees and managers in Finland, collaborating with relevant local stakeholders and authorities when needed. Provide guidance on Finnish employment law, employee relations, local regulations and market practices, including dialogue with unions where relevant.
